reviews.name: Hataichanok Pandith
reviews.text:
Disappointing booking experience.
I contacted Luna Wow Massage to make a booking with a specific therapist. At 12:58 PM, I clearly provided my preferred date and time (Next Thursday at 6:00 PM). I then waited until 1:15 PM without receiving any acknowledgement or update that the therapist's availability was being checked, so I had to follow up myself.
Only after I followed up was I told that the therapist is freelance and that the shop needed to check his schedule first. I completely understand that a freelance therapist's availability cannot be confirmed immediately. My concern is not that the booking could not be confirmed — it is the communication.
A simple message such as, “We are checking the therapist's availability and will get back to you shortly,” would have been sufficient and would have prevented the misunderstanding.
I had used this shop before and previously experienced much faster communication. Unfortunately, this experience made me decide not to proceed with the booking and to use another massage service instead.
I hope the shop can improve its booking communication and customer service, especially when customers are waiting for confirmation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Miss, we are sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction with our communication speed. Our shop is not focused on quantity but on quality, so it may at times be so that our Well-Being Manager is busy handling a customer and making sure that she is alright.
A reaction speed of more than 17min on a booking is therefore possible and in our view acceptable for a dedicated personalised services as we offer.
If you want to buy a ticket for the next bus and you're in a rush, you of course want to buy your ticket within a few minutes, but we are not in a business of client in - client out, we focus on highly personal, private services.
We regret that you do not judge us on the quality of services that we provide but only on a somewhat slower answer to book. There is a saying: do not judge the book by its cover. But in this case, you do not even judge the book on it's cover but on it's delivery time. If so, it may be to pick up a newspaper on the road instead of ordering that special book that one can't find anywhere else.
We do check on communication skills of our Well Being Managers and if hope there are misunderstandings or our reaction is sufficient, we will improve on that.
We hope you can understand what kind of service we provide, thank you.

title: Lar Thai Massage หล้านวดแผนไทย
subTitle: Lar's Thai Massage หล้านวดแผนไทย
ownerDescription:
A master Thai masseuse with more than three decades of experience, what you won't find at Lar's humble establishment is a long list of treatments in a gimmicky environment, nor will you find a man who seeks to squeeze as many massages into his day to maximize profit.

What you will discover is a generous healer who believes that his skill should remain affordable to those who need it and that in order to do his best work, he must limit himself to a handful of treatments per day.
In a modern Thailand where tourists are so often called into massage parlours only to encounter superficial services at unjustified prices, Lar serves as an inspired professional whose focus remains to share his culture’s healing tradition with those who seek it.

reviews.text:
사진보다 실물이 훨씬 깔끔하고 깨끗해요!

예약 후 방문했는데 처음에는 아무도 저에게 관심을 가져주지 않아서 뻘쭘 그 자체…😂 잠시 후 담당 관리사님이 오셔서 안내해 주셨어요.

마사지 중간중간 옆에 계신 분과 계속 수다 타임을 가지셨지만, 크게 불편하지는 않았어요.

무엇보다 마사지 강약 조절을 잘해주셨고, 어깨도 시원하게 스트레칭해 주셔서 정말 개운했습니다.

한 가지 아쉬운 점은 모기가 있어서 조금 불편했다는 것 정도예요.

그래도 가격 대비 마사지 만족도는 매우 높았습니다.
가성비 좋은 마사지샵으로 추천해요! 최고! 👍
reviews.textTranslated:
It looks much neater and cleaner in person than in the photos!

I visited after making a reservation, and at first, no one paid me any attention, so I felt incredibly awkward... 😂 A short while later, my assigned therapist came over and showed me around.

She kept chatting with the person next to her throughout the massage, but it wasn't too uncomfortable.

Above all, she adjusted the pressure perfectly, and the shoulder stretches left me feeling incredibly refreshed.

The only downside was that there were mosquitoes, which was a bit inconvenient.

Still, considering the price, I was very satisfied with the massage.

I recommend this as a great value massage shop! The best! 👍

reviews.name: YU
reviews.text:
アソーク駅からスカイウォークで直結しているため、雨の日でも一切濡れずにアクセスできました。

お部屋の温度管理が絶妙で、照明やインテリアの雰囲気も最高にリラックスできる空間が広がっています。

担当してくださったセラピストの方の力加減が本当に心地よく、凝り固まっていた体が芯からほぐれていくのが分かりました。力加減の確認も丁寧で、最初から最後まで安心してお任せできました。

これだけ贅沢な空間と高い技術力がありながら、コストパフォーマンスも非常に良く、大満足の時間を過ごせました。自分へのご褒美に、ぜひまたリピートさせていただきます！
reviews.textTranslated:
Because it's directly connected to Asok Station via a skywalk, I was able to access it without getting wet even on a rainy day.

The room temperature was perfectly controlled, and the lighting and interior design created a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere.

The therapist's pressure was incredibly comfortable; I could feel my stiff muscles loosening up from the core. They were very thorough in checking the pressure level, and I felt completely at ease from start to finish.

Despite the luxurious space and high level of skill, the cost performance was excellent, and I had a truly satisfying experience. I will definitely be coming back again as a treat for myself!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
この度は当スパをご利用いただき、誠にありがとうございます。また、大変励みになる嬉しいレビューをご投稿くださり、スタッフ一同心より御礼申し上げます。
アソーク駅からのアクセスやお部屋の雰囲気、そして担当セラピストの施術にご満足いただけたとのこと、大変光栄に存じます。
お客様が心からリラックスできるよう、空間づくりや丁寧な力加減の確認には特にこだわっておりますので、「お体が芯からほぐれた」とお聞きし、安心いたしました。
今後もより一層の技術・サービス向上に努めてまいります。
ぜひまた、日々のご褒美としてお疲れを癒やしにいらしてください。

title: SALA Spa Choengmon
ownerDescription:
SALA Spa Choengmon is a peaceful sanctuary within SALA Samui Choengmon Beach Resort, devoted to traditional Thai healing in a setting of understated luxury. The spa features four air-conditioned treatment rooms accented with warm teak wood, alongside a signature massage pavilion designed to “float” above a tranquil lotus pond.
At the heart of the experience is the SALA Signature Massage, a distinctive blend of Hawaiian Lomi Lomi, Swedish and Balinese techniques. Whether you are seeking a comprehensive SALA Samui spa package or a focused wellness retreat, our therapists create a refined, minimalist environment designed for complete rejuvenation. Located on the quiet sands of Choeng Mon Beach our luxury spa is open daily from 10.00am - 8.00am

reviews.name: k t
reviews.text:
タイ旅行滞在中、到着日と出発日の2回通っています。
（到着日は長旅で疲れた顔と身体を癒しに、出発日は施術をしてもらい綺麗な顔や身体のまま飛行機に乗る。）
いろいろなメニューをやって来ましたが、最近、アロママッサージ&フェイシャルトリートメント2時間1700bahtが気に入って続けて施術してもらっています。
ここのセラピストさんはみなさんとても上手でクオリティーが高く誰に当たっても素晴らしく気持ちがいいです。

BTSアソーク駅直結Times Squareビル3階で雨や日差しを避けて行くことができとても便利。
予約はLINEから日本語でできます。
私はタイ語に翻訳して送ったら日本語で帰って来ました（笑）

受付の男性は多分韓国の方ですが日本語、英語が堪能で不自由なく会話が進められます。

かれこれ20年近く通っていますがここが本当におすすめ！
reviews.textTranslated:
During my trips to Thailand, I visit twice: once on my arrival day and once on my departure day.
(On arrival, I go to soothe my tired face and body after a long journey; on departure, I get a treatment so I can board the plane with a beautiful face and body.)
I've tried various treatments, but recently I've been enjoying the 2-hour aromatherapy massage & facial treatment for 1700 baht and have been getting it regularly.
All the therapists here are very skilled and high-quality; no matter who you get, it's wonderful and relaxing.
It's conveniently located on the 3rd floor of the Times Square building, directly connected to BTS Asok station, so you can avoid the rain and sun.
Reservations can be made in Japanese via LINE.
I sent it translated into Thai, but they replied in Japanese! (laughs)
The man at the reception is probably Korean, but he's fluent in Japanese and English, so communication is easy.
I've been going there for almost 20 years now, and I highly recommend it!

reviews.textTranslated: I'm a tourist who went because of good reviews. I usually get massages regularly. I had a massage on September 29th, 2026, for 800 baht for two hours. Before the massage, I told the masseuse to focus on my neck and right shoulder. The masseuse started by massaging the areas where I had problems, which I must commend for her attentiveness. However, the problem was that she wasn't pressing on the exact spots where I was hurting. Normally, a professional masseuse would know exactly where to release tension. During the massage, she moved to other areas. I told her about the neck and right shoulder, and while it eased a little, the pain radiated down to my shoulder blade. The masseuse didn't focus on addressing the radiating pain. Even now, 10 days later, I still have radiating pain in my shoulder blade.

reviews.textTranslated:
I was dissatisfied with the massage I received at another place earlier in the day, and since I had just finished browsing the Sunday Market, I visited after 9 PM to get a foot massage. It was great that this shop stayed open late, unlike other nearby shops. Perhaps because it was late, they dimmed the lights slightly, so I was able to close my eyes and receive the massage comfortably. The one-hour foot massage went by so quickly. They washed my feet with warm water at the entrance, and the massage proceeded on a sofa inside.

It was my first time getting a massage from a male masseur, and the pressure was really good. He used a pressure point stick to loosen up my muscles delicately, and when he massaged my shoulders and neck at the end, that brief moment felt even more refreshing than the neck massages I've received at other places!!

It's a shame I didn't ask for his name, but he was a middle-aged man.

The best foot massage I've received in Chiang Mai👍🏻 It was the only massage shop where I gave a tip. Sir... why did I only find out about this now...^_ㅠ..

reviews.name: Aigul Natfullina
reviews.text:
Место очень красивое и атмосферное. Владелец постарался и реально вложил много денег на создание такой красоты. Но почему то не вложился в мастеров, иначе я не могу объяснить тот факт, что массаж за 600 бат (oil massage) был самым худшим на острове.

Возможно я что-то не понимаю, но поглаживание в течение 60 минут это точно не oil massage. Тогда зачем нужна анкета в начале процедуры, где я указала что мне нужен deep massage с проработкой определённых точек.

Идешь с ожиданием вау массажа, потому что то как тебя встречают, заводят в отдельную комнату, чувствует атмосфера дорого спа, а по факту получаешь такое.

После процедуры ко мне подошел менеджер, чтобы спросить что меня не устроило( не понятно с какой целью, если они мне не предложили ничего, чтобы хоть как-то оставить хорошее впечатление о месте)

Возмножо нам попался такой Мастер, потому что моему мужу тоже не понравился массаж.
reviews.textTranslated:
The place is very beautiful and atmospheric. The owner really put a lot of effort into creating such beauty. But for some reason, he didn't invest in the therapists; otherwise, I can't explain the fact that the 600 baht oil massage was the worst on the island.

Maybe I'm missing something, but 60 minutes of stroking is definitely not an oil massage. Then why did they need to fill out a form at the beginning of the treatment, where I indicated that I wanted a deep massage with specific pressure points?

You go expecting a wow massage because of the way they greet you, lead you into a private room, and the ambiance of an expensive spa, but in reality, you get this.

After the treatment, the manager approached me to ask what I wasn't happy with (it's unclear why, since they didn't offer me anything to leave a good impression).

We ended up with a therapist who was so unsatisfactory because my husband didn't like the massage either.

reviews.name: Polina Vishnyakova
reviews.text:
Безумно красивое спа! Начиная от самого здания, которое является традиционный тайским домом, заканчивая маленькими бело-голубыми фарфоровыми чашечками для чая после массажа.

Цена умеренная, я бы даже сказала, что достаточно дешево для такого спа. Брали с мужем тайский массаж на 1,5 часа и заплатили за двоих 1200 бат.

Мне массаж очень понравилась, мастер промяла все указанные мной в опроснике места как положено. Но и я специально просила делать массаж strong/deep.

После массажа нам предложили теплый чай и клейкий рис с кокосовым соусом и личи.

Обратите внимание, что у спа есть утренние часы, когда массаж еще дешевле. Но потребуется оплатить депозит в 500 бат как подтверждение вашего прихода.
reviews.textTranslated:
An absolutely beautiful spa! From the building itself, a traditional Thai house, to the small blue and white porcelain cups for tea after the massage.

The price is reasonable; I'd even say quite affordable for a spa of this size. My husband and I booked a 1.5-hour Thai massage for 1,200 baht for both of us.

I really enjoyed the massage; the therapist thoroughly massaged all the areas I'd specified in the questionnaire. I also specifically asked for a strong/deep massage.

After the massage, we were offered warm tea and sticky rice with coconut sauce and lychee.

Please note that the spa has morning hours, when massages are even cheaper. A 500 baht deposit is required to confirm your arrival.

reviews.name: sensingman
reviews.text:
마사지는 가격이나 시설보다는 마사지사의 능력과 성실함이 좌우한다는 진실을 다시 한 번 깨닫게된 곳.
비싼 만큼 시설은 깔끔했고 사전에 태블릿에 신체부위별로 마사지의 강도를  요청하는 등 규격화된 루틴이 있었으며 마사지사끼리 잡담을 한다든지 하는 비매너 역시 없었음.
그러나 나는 남자고 강한 마사지를 원한다고 했음에도 90분 내내 아기 마사지 하듯 어루만지다가 끝나버림. 마사지를 받고도 찝찝한 기분이 드는건 어쩔 수 없었음.
같이 마사지를 받은 일행은 좋았다고 하는걸 보니 마사지사가 잘못 걸린듯 함.
이 곳을 선택한 이유 중 하나는 비싼 만큼 마사지사의 능력 편차가 크지 않을것이라는 기대 때문이었는데 매우 실망스러웠음.
굳이 비싼 마사지 받을 이유가 없다는 교훈을 새삼스럽게 얻게된 곳.
reviews.textTranslated:
This place made me realize once again the truth that a massage is determined by the masseuse's skill and sincerity, rather than the price or facilities.

The facilities were clean, befitting the high price, and there was a standardized routine, such as requesting massage intensity for specific body parts via a tablet beforehand. There was also no bad manners, such as masseuses chatting amongst themselves.

However, despite stating that I am a man and wanted a strong massage, the masseuse spent the entire 90 minutes stroking me like she was massaging a baby, and it ended abruptly. I couldn't help feeling uneasy even after receiving the massage.

Seeing as my companion who received a massage with me said it was good, it seems I just got the wrong masseuse.

One of the reasons I chose this place was the expectation that the variation in the masseuses' abilities wouldn't be significant given the high price, but I was very disappointed.

It was a place where I learned the lesson once again that there is no real reason to go out of my way to pay for an expensive massage.

reviews.text:
We've been loyal Let's Relax customers for years and have so many good memories of their spas, so I was really looking forward to my appointment at the M Social Hotel branch in Patong on 4 October at 7:30 p.m. Unfortunately, it was a big disappointment.

The air conditioning wasn't working, and the treatment room was uncomfortably hot the entire time. It's impossible to relax when you're sweating through a massage. After a long, tiring day, this was the opposite of what I booked for.

After I complained, they did give me a refund, which I appreciate. But a refund doesn't make up for a ruined evening. For such a big spa inside a five-star hotel, I expected much better. A cool, comfortable room is the most basic part of a spa experience.

I hope management fixes this quickly, because this branch doesn't live up to the Let's Relax standard we know and love.

The worst massage I've ever had in Pattaya.
- Interior 4 out of 10
- Friendly staff 4 out of 10
- Cleanliness 6 out of 10
- Attention to guest 1 out of 10
- Relaxing atmosphere 1 out of 10
- Massage itself 1 out of 10
There wasn't even an attempt to give a good massage. They just poured oil on me and spread it around with their palms. The staff was constantly making noise outside the door. They didn't offer to wash my feet or give me disposable underwear. The entire massage, I was thinking only one thing... I wished it would be over.

reviews.name: Natthamone Poomichai
reviews.text: เป็นสปาที่มาแล้วสบายตาสบายตัวจริงๆ เพราะบรรยากาศโดยรอบกว้างขวางสะอาดสะอ้าน มีต้นไม้ใหญ่ร่มรื่นสวยงามเหมือนมาเที่ยวรีสอร์ทกลางเมืองภูเก็ต  ที่นั่งพักรับรองแขกก็โปร่งโล่งสบายสวยงามด้วยการตกแต่งแนวธรรมชาติ  ระหว่างนั่งรอรับบริการนวดได้กลิ่นหอมอ่อนๆชื่นใจโชยมาจากไหนไม่รู้  มารู้ทีหลัง หลังจากที่นวดเสร็จแล้วว่ามันคือกลิ่นน้ำชาที่เจ้าของสปาเขาผลิตชาจากสมุนไพรที่ปลูกไว้ใช้งานเองภายในสปา ชาเขาหอมอร่อยชื่นใจ ขนมคุ้กกี้สุขภาพรูปร่างน่ารักเขาก็ทำเอง รู้สึกประทับใจมาก ยิ่งมาพูดถึงบริการนวดจากฝีมือหมอนวดชื่อดาว  ต้องเรียกว่าขั้นเทพ เรานวดไทยใช้ยาหม่อง 2ชั่วโมง รู้สึกตัวเบาสบายหายปวดหายเมื่อย  บริการต้อนรับลํกค้าของพรรณนาราเขาก็อ่อนโยนแบบไทยๆ พนักงานมีแต่รอยยิ้ม เครื่องใช้ไม้สอยอุปกรณ์เขาก็สะอาดสะอ้านมาก ห้องนวดแยกเป็นสัดเป็นส่วนห้องต่อห้องเลย  ที่จริงเขามีบริการนวดหลากหลายแบบให้เลือกนะ ทั้งนวดน้ำมันแบบ hot oil, นวดหินร้อน และนวดอื่นๆ คราวนี้มานวดไทย  ไว้คราวหน้าจะมาลองนวดแบบอื่น  เพราะติดใจในสภาพแวดล้อมและบริการของที่นี่   PHANNARA SPAอยู่ใกล้ห้างเซ๊นทรัลภูเก็ต สาขาบายพาสต์นิดเดียว
reviews.textTranslated: This spa is truly relaxing and soothing. The surroundings are spacious, clean, and beautifully shaded by large trees, making it feel like a resort in the middle of Phuket city. The waiting areas are airy, comfortable, and beautifully decorated in a natural style. While waiting for my massage, I smelled a light, refreshing aroma wafting from somewhere. I later found out after the massage that it was the scent of tea that the spa owner makes from herbs grown on-site. Their tea is fragrant, delicious, and refreshing. They also make their own cute, healthy cookies. I was very impressed. And the massage itself, performed by the masseuse named Dao, was absolutely amazing. I had a two-hour Thai massage using balm, and I felt light, relaxed, and all my aches and pains were gone. The customer service at Phannara is gentle and traditionally Thai. The staff are always smiling, and the equipment and facilities are spotlessly clean. The massage rooms are separate and private. They actually offer a variety of massages, including hot oil massage, hot stone massage, and others. This time I had a Thai massage, but next time I'll try other types because I'm so impressed with the environment and service. PHANNARA SPA is located near Central Phuket Bypass.

reviews.textTranslated: I've been getting massages here for a very long time. Today, Wednesday, October 7th, 2026, at 7:00 PM, I went for my usual massage at my regular shop. A female masseuse came to massage me; I'd never seen her before. She had an unfriendly expression and was the worst masseuse I've ever met. I often come here because the previous masseuses have always been excellent. I felt the shop maintained a good standard, but this one was unbearable. She massaged like she hadn't been trained at all; she was completely clueless and acted like she was angry at someone else. I told her it hurt and asked her to go easier, but she did the same thing. I wanted to tell her to change professions. She had no customer service skills and lacked the necessary abilities. I've always been impressed with her, but this experience left me extremely frustrated. The shop should maintain its standards in hiring its staff.

reviews.name: Nataliya Novikova
reviews.text:
Это был один из самых потрясающих массажей в моей жизни! ❤️

Я уже четыре дня в Бангкоке, успела побывать в разных местах и попробовать разные впечатления, но именно здесь меня ждало настоящее открытие.

Массаж у Nitta — это не просто массаж, это настоящее искусство! Она работает с невероятной любовью к своему делу и при этом чувствуется настоящий профессионализм. Она буквально чувствует тело и знает, где нужно проработать глубже, а где быть особенно бережной.

Особенно я была впечатлена тем, как Nitta освободила мою поясницу и проработала ноги. После массажа я почувствовала такую лёгкость, будто с меня сняли огромную тяжесть.

Атмосфера, ароматы, её руки, внимание к каждой детали… Всё это создало ощущение полного погружения и наслаждения. ✨

Я вышла оттуда и подумала: «Вот это я понимаю — тайский массаж!»

У меня действительно было ощущение, будто раскрылись крылья, а ноги сами понесли меня вперёд! 🪽

Nitta, огромное спасибо за ваши золотые руки, профессионализм и любовь к своей работе! 🙏❤️

Если вы в Бангкоке и ищете действительно хорошего мастера — очень рекомендую попасть именно к Nitta. Я обязательно вернусь!
reviews.textTranslated:
This was one of the most amazing massages of my life! ❤️

I've been in Bangkok for four days now, and I've visited many places and experienced different things, but this one was a true revelation.

Nitta's massage isn't just a massage, it's a true art! She works with incredible passion for her craft, and you can feel her true professionalism. She literally feels your body and knows where to go deeper and where to be especially gentle.

I was especially impressed by how Nitta released my lower back and worked my legs. After the massage, I felt so light, as if a huge weight had been lifted.

The atmosphere, the aromas, her hands, the attention to every detail… All of it created a feeling of complete immersion and pleasure. ✨

I left there and thought, "Now this is what I call a Thai massage!"

I truly felt like wings had opened, and my legs were carrying me forward! 🪽

Nitta, thank you so much for your golden touch, professionalism, and passion for your work! 🙏❤️

If you're in Bangkok and looking for a truly good stylist, I highly recommend Nitta. I'll definitely be back!

If I could give 0 stars, I would. This was the worst massage experience I’ve ever had.

My first visit for a foot massage was decent, and since the location was convenient, I decided to return for an oil massage with my boyfriend after the staff recommended it. Unfortunately, I was extremely disappointed.

1. No proper storage for belongings. We had to leave our bags on the floor.

2. Extremely rushed and careless massage. There was absolutely nothing relaxing about it. The therapist barely worked on my muscles and seemed to be rushing just to finish the session.

I asked her to focus more on my shoulders and calves, but she insisted she had already done so. When I asked again, she painfully pressed her elbow into my muscles. I requested that she use her hands instead, but she replied, “I don’t have enough strength left because I just finished giving another customer a foot massage.”

She also told me that oil massages only involve medium pressure and that I should pay extra for a deep tissue massage if I wanted something stronger.

If the therapist was too exhausted to do her job properly, why wasn’t someone else assigned to me? I’m a paying customer too! I wasn’t asking for anything unreasonable. The massage was so ridiculously light that even someone without professional training could have done better. I’ve had oil massages elsewhere, and the quality was miles ahead of this place.

I spent the entire session waiting for it to end. I normally tip therapists even when the massage isn’t great, but this time I simply couldn’t.

Now I understand why the reviews seem to be either one star or five stars, especially since customers are offered a free foot massage on their next visit for leaving a five-star review. I certainly won’t be returning.

I complained to the receptionist before leaving, but I’m not sure how seriously my feedback was taken.

An absolute waste of money and time. I left feeling like I hadn’t even had a massage. Never again.
reviews.textTranslated:
(TH/EN) If there were 0 stars, I would give 0 stars. This was the worst massage experience I've ever had. The first time I went, it was a foot massage, and I thought it was okay, the location was good. So I asked if the oil massage here was light, and they said it was very good, any masseuse would do.
The second time I went, I brought my boyfriend, and we were both very disappointed.
1. There's no place to store our bags; we had to put them on the floor.
2. The massage was extremely fast. There was absolutely no relaxation. There was no deep tissue massage; it was just a perfunctory massage. I asked for more emphasis on my shoulders and calves, and they said they would, adding that the person next to me who started at the same time as me had already had their legs massaged. So, they already emphasized my shoulders and calves! When they emphasized again, they used their elbow to massage, which was painful. So I asked for their hands to massage, but the masseuse said she didn't have the strength because she had just massaged feet (for the previous client). She also said that oil massages are of medium intensity, and if I wanted a stronger massage, I had to go for a deep tissue massage, which is a different price. I want to ask, if her fingers don't have the strength, why not have someone else massage me? I'm a customer, and I'm paying for it too. I wasn't asking for too much emphasis. The massages they usually give are very light; even someone who isn't a masseuse would be better at it. Compared to other places, their oil massages are much better. And I didn't feel relaxed at all while waiting for the massage to finish. Normally, if the masseuse isn't great, I always tip, but this was really unacceptable. Now I understand why reviews are either 1 or 5 stars; if you give a 5-star review, you get a free foot massage on your next visit, which I won't be doing. I complained to the receptionist when I left, but I don't know how much they understood. In short, I regret spending my money and time there. It wasn't like a massage at all. Compared to other shops I've been to, it's very far away.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. This was the worst massage experience I’ve ever had.

My first visit for a foot massage was decent, and since the location was convenient, I decided to return for an oil massage with my boyfriend after the staff recommended it. Unfortunately, I was extremely disappointed.

1. No proper storage for belongings. We had to leave our bags on the floor.

2. Extremely rushed and careless massage. There was absolutely nothing relaxing about it. The therapist barely worked on my muscles and seemed to be rushing just to finish the session.

I asked her to focus more on my shoulders and calves, but she insisted she had already done so. When I asked again, she painfully pressed her elbow into my muscles. I requested that she use her hands instead, but she replied, “I don’t have enough strength left because I just finished giving another customer a foot massage.”

She also told me that oil massages only involve medium pressure and that I should pay extra for a deep tissue massage if I wanted something stronger.

If the therapist was too exhausted to do her job properly, why wasn’t someone else assigned to me? I'm a paying customer too! I wasn't asking for anything unreasonable. The massage was so ridiculously light that even someone without professional training could have done better. I’ve had oil massages elsewhere, and the quality was miles ahead of this place.

I spent the entire session waiting for it to end. I normally tip therapists even when the massage isn’t great, but this time I simply couldn’t.

Now I understand why the reviews seem to be either one star or five stars, especially since customers are offered a free foot massage on their next visit for leaving a five-star review. I certainly won't be returning.

I complained to the receptionist before leaving, but I’m not sure how seriously my feedback was taken.

An absolute waste of money and time. I left feeling like I hadn't even had a massage. Never again.

reviews.text:
フットマッサージ1時間を受けました。
はじめの5分に行った施術と全く同じことを1時間繰り返すだけでした。
足の甲を擦ってスネに流して膝をくるくる。
足裏をもう少しほぐして欲しかったですが撫でる程度。
あまりの酷さに受けながらまだ営業しているほかのマッサージ屋さんを検索しました笑
1時間座って特に足の疲れが軽くなる事なく退店しました。
お値段の安さで★2はつけるけど内容は1かな。
reviews.textTranslated:
I had a one-hour foot massage.

The massage consisted of repeating the exact same thing for the entire hour as it was for the first five minutes.

They rubbed the tops of my feet, moved down to my shins, and rubbed my knees in circles.

I wanted them to massage the soles of my feet a bit more, but they only lightly stroked them.

It was so bad that I started searching for other massage parlors that were still open while I was receiving the massage, lol.

After sitting there for an hour, my feet didn't feel any less tired, and I left the shop.

I'd give it two stars because of the low price, but the quality of the service deserves a one.

Did I open the gates of heaven or the gates of hell?

The facilities were really shabby, but the massage was incredibly refreshing. It seemed like they put a lot of thought into it, so I felt grateful.

추천하지 않습니다
reviews.textTranslated:
As of May 7, 2026

1-hour Thai massage is 200 baht. You can request focused treatment on specific areas (via translator).

When you open the front door and go inside, the owner is present.

Tell them your desired time and areas, and make the payment (Gln works!).

They will give you a laminated card.

Once you are guided to your assigned masseur,

just hand the card to the masseur.

I was treated by a male masseur, and I liked that he didn't just rub, but pinpointed the muscles and pressed with pressure!

As mentioned in other reviews,

the environment itself isn't particularly great.

If you want a more private setting where you feel welcomed,

I do not recommend it.

โดยรวมไม่ประทับใจและรู้สึกว่าไม่คุ้มกับเงินที่จ่ายไปครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
I had a terrible experience at For Rest Health Massage, where I opted for a body scrub and milk bath package.

The milk used for the massage was very cold, not warm at all, even though it was supposed to be a milk bath service. The air-conditioned room was already very cold, but they added an extra fan. I informed the staff several times, but they didn't adjust the temperature, making me feel cold and uncomfortable throughout the service.

The massage itself was very mediocre; the massage technique wasn't good, and I didn't feel relaxed or comfortable at all. I expected a better experience but was very disappointed.

Overall, I was unimpressed and felt it wasn't worth the money.

처음 적당한압 물어보셔서 말씀드리고나니 편안하게 받을수 있었습니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
I used the discounted package at Kowabi during weekday daytime hours.

It was great to be able to travel comfortably via the BTS during the rainy season.

First, after a foot scrub, I lay down on the bed and the massage began with a singing bowl. Maybe it was just my imagination, but I suddenly felt drowsy and relaxed.

While getting a massage, I tend to say "Nak Nak" and "Bao Bao" at least once.

They asked me at the beginning about the appropriate pressure, and once I told them, I was able to receive the massage comfortably.

reviews.name: sun2
reviews.text: 올해 초 고와비로 알게되어 방문했다가 서울 5성급 호텔 스파 컨디션을 뛰어넘는 고급스러운 분위기에 고와비 바우처 가격이 너무 좋아서 재방문하였습니다. 센트럴월드와 연결된 5성급 호텔의 스파라 입지가 너무 좋고 방이 많아서 대기가 없습니다. 지난 방문 때 친절하게 안내해주신 리셉션의 Kochamon(lotus)님을 다시 만나서 기뻤고 이번 방문 때도 역시나 프로페셔널했습니다. 스파가 항상 깔끔하게 관리되고 있고 조용하여 휴식하기 좋습니다. 스파 후 건너편 빅C마트에서 기념품을 사는 코스도 추천합니다.
reviews.textTranslated: I first visited earlier this year after discovering it through Kowabi, and I returned because the luxurious atmosphere surpassed the standards of 5-star hotel spas in Seoul, and the price offered via the Kowabi voucher was excellent. As a spa located in a 5-star hotel connected to Central World, the location is superb, and there are plenty of rooms, so there is no waiting list. I was delighted to meet Kochamon (Lotus) at the reception again, who kindly assisted me during my last visit, and he was just as professional this time as well. The spa is always impeccably maintained and quiet, making it a great place to relax. I also recommend a course where you shop for souvenirs at the Big C Mart across the street after your spa treatment.

reviews.name: Sereno
reviews.text:
센타라호텔 26층에 위치
센바리 스파 갓성비인건 유명하니 더 말할게 없고, gowabi app 에서 사전에 스파 이용권 구매 예약 방문했습니다. 마사지 전 온센 사우나 시설 이용할수 있어서 만족도 높았구요 테라피스트 실력 또한 좋습니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
Located on the 26th floor of the Centara Hotel.

Senbari Spa is famous for its incredible value, so there is nothing more to say. I visited after purchasing a spa pass and making a reservation in advance via the Gowabi app. I was very satisfied because I could use the onsen sauna facilities before the massage, and the therapist's skills were also excellent.

reviewContext.Services: Spa packages, Body scrub, Massage therapy

reviews.name: 성정민
reviews.text:
한국인 후기 많이 보여서 갔는데 그냥 그저 그래요.
아로마는  압이없어서 그냥 누워서 잠깐 눈붙이는  용도 입니다.  같이간 가족들 이야기로 호텔스파 이번일정에 3군데 체험했는데 제일 별로라는,.
그냥 마치고 목욕 잠깐하고 비행기 탈수있는걸로 만족.
reviews.textTranslated:
I went because I saw a lot of reviews from Koreans, but it was just so-so.

The aromatherapy massage lacked pressure, so it's only really suitable for lying down and taking a quick nap. According to my family, who went with me, they tried three hotel spas on this trip and this was the worst.

I was just satisfied with being able to take a quick bath and catch my flight.

reviews.name: Jan Martin
reviews.text: Kanokwan, Tommysan, Rose, Aom (and Cocochan) are the dream team teaching with the right balance of love, humour, ease and focus. I would recommend this school for someone looking to gain a broad skill set in traditional Thai massage and also for their classes on lymphatic drainage, oil massage, facial massage, herbal ball massage and foot massage. All courses can be completed as part of a therapist training and accommodation on site is a great idea. Lunches are delicious and support a local restaurant. Every morning starts with optional traditional Thai prayer, yoga and meditation before a day of study. I loved every day of a forty-eight day journey with TTC. Individual courses can also be purchased and completed for shorter stays in Chiang Mai. For this I would recommend level one Thai massage or their new dynamic Thai massage course. I look forward to returning in the future to study Tok-Sen and further my Thai massage training. THANK YOU TEAM TTC!

reviews.name: Fatma Benjaouahdou
reviews.text:
TTC Spa School was an absolutely amazing experience! ❤️ Everything was perfect from start to finish. All the teachers are wonderful, professional, patient, and genuinely passionate about what they do. I learned so much and truly enjoyed every moment of my training.

The food was lovely, the accommodation was perfect, and the whole environment was comfortable and welcoming. I felt very well taken care of throughout my stay.

I’m so grateful for this experience and would highly recommend TTC Spa School to anyone looking for excellent massage training in Thailand. Thank you to all the teachers and the whole TTC team for making my experience so special! 🙏✨
A big kiss to Cocochan 🐶 ♥️

reviews.name: Oziel Gerardo Del Angel Lopez
reviews.text:
I spent 6 weeks at TTC to learn authentic Thai massage and to deepen my understanding of Thai culture, and it was an outstanding experience from beginning to end.

The classes and teachers are highly professional, incredibly knowledgeable, and follow a very well-structured learning sequence that makes the techniques easier to understand and practice step by step. You can feel that the teaching approach has been designed with great care to support students throughout the learning process.

The school itself has a beautiful atmosphere. It feels like a place built with genuine love, attention, and intention, and that shows in every detail. Everything is thoughtfully arranged to make the student experience warm, comfortable, and truly memorable.

The food available at the school is also delicious and authentically Thai, which adds even more to the overall experience.

For anyone looking to learn authentic Thai massage in Chiang Mai, I can wholeheartedly say that TTC is not only one of the best schools in Chiang Mai, but one of the best in all of Thailand.

reviews.name: Sabine Lumbroso
reviews.text:
Je suis venue en Thaïlande pour me former au massage dans le but de devenir thérapeute professionnelle, et j’ai choisi TTC Spa School. Je ne regrette absolument pas ce choix.

Tout d’abord, le lieu est magnifique. Tout est pensé pour offrir un environnement propice à l’apprentissage tout en étant agréable et apaisant. L’ambiance est à la fois détendue et très sérieuse. La devise de l’école, “Happy Together”, reflète parfaitement l’esprit qui y règne au quotidien : bienveillance, partage et respect.

Les cours sont dispensés avec beaucoup de professionnalisme et de bienveillance. Les enseignants sont toujours présents, attentifs, corrigent nos gestes en permanence et nous permettent de pratiquer sur de nombreuses personnes, ce qui est un véritable atout pour progresser rapidement.

Les examens sont essentiellement basés sur la pratique. Si l’on travaille sérieusement tout au long de la formation, ils sont tout à fait accessibles et mérités.

Je repars avec de solides compétences, une vraie confiance en moi et la satisfaction d’avoir reçu une formation de grande qualité. Je recommande cette école sans hésitation à toute personne souhaitant apprendre le massage dans un cadre à la fois exigeant, humain et inspirant.

Happy Together n’est pas seulement une devise : c’est une réalité que l’on vit chaque jour au sein de cette école.
reviews.textTranslated:
I came to Thailand to train in massage with the goal of becoming a professional therapist, and I chose TTC Spa School. I absolutely do not regret this choice.

First of all, the location is magnificent. Everything is designed to offer an environment conducive to learning while remaining pleasant and calming. The atmosphere is both relaxed and very professional. The school's motto, "Happy Together," perfectly reflects the spirit that prevails there daily: kindness, sharing, and respect.

The courses are taught with great professionalism and kindness. The instructors are always present, attentive, constantly correcting our techniques and allowing us to practice on many clients, which is a real advantage for rapid progress.

The exams are primarily based on practical application. If you work diligently throughout the training, they are entirely achievable and well-deserved.

I am leaving with solid skills, real self-confidence, and the satisfaction of having received high-quality training. I wholeheartedly recommend this school to anyone wishing to learn massage in a demanding, supportive, and inspiring environment.

Happy Together isn't just a motto; it's a reality we experience every day at this school.

reviews.name: Cecile Le Bras
reviews.text:
Juste quelques jours de cours, mais de suite on sent l'ambiance chaleureuse et accueillante de Kanock et des professeurs.
Merci de votre disponibilité,  de votre belle énergie et de ce lieu agréable.
reviews.textTranslated:
Just a few days of classes, but you immediately feel the warm and welcoming atmosphere of Kanock and the teachers.
Thank you for your availability, your wonderful energy, and this lovely place.

reviews.textTranslated:
Terrible experience. I told the therapist to "harder" twice, yet the pressure remained laughably light—literally like rubbing my feet. I felt completely ignored and wasted my time and money. If you're used to proper Thai or sports massage, stay away from this place unless they change their staff. I will not be coming back, and I advise others to confirm the therapist's strength before starting.

It was touching my feet, not massaging them. There was absolutely no pressure, and even when I asked for more, they wouldn't budge. The therapist was distracted, looking at the street the entire time.

It felt suffocating; I had no idea what I was doing.

I paid money to suffer.

reviews.name: M I
reviews.text:
私の場合、他の学校で一通りタイマッサージの資格を取得していたので、
なんとか授業には追いつけましたが、
ハードスケジュールに慣れるまでは大変でした😅
全くの未経験者だと5daysのベーシックコースからスタートした方がよさそうなイメージです😊
でも、本当にこちらの先生達はとても熱心でした。私は身長も低く、手も小さかったので、
私用にポジション調整や違うやり方を提案して下さりました。
他の学校だと、分からない。と言われることを、マイ先生とアイ先生は必ず答えを出してくれました。正直、こんなに料金が安いのに、
熱心に指導して下さりとてもびっくりしました。
あとは、今まで気づかなかった自分の癖やこういうやり方の方が痛くないんだ🤔と気付かされることが多くて、本当に勉強になりました。
次はどのコースを受けようか考えてるくらい、またリピートしたい学校です🙂‍↕️
reviews.textTranslated:
In my case, I had already obtained a Thai massage qualification from another school, so I was able to keep up with the classes, but it was tough getting used to the demanding schedule. 😅 For complete beginners, I think it's best to start with the 5-day basic course. 😊
However, the teachers here were truly dedicated. Because I'm short and have small hands, they adjusted my position and suggested different techniques.
While other schools would say, "We don't know," Mai-sensei and Ai-sensei always provided answers. Honestly, I was very surprised by their dedication to instruction, especially considering the low price.
Also, I learned a lot about my own habits and discovered techniques that are less painful. 🤔 It was truly educational.
I'm already thinking about which course to take next; it's a school I'd definitely want to return to! 🙂‍↕️

reviews.name: Jose Oviedo
reviews.text:
Me encuentro cursando el Teacher Training Program que ofrece esta escuela y, sinceramente, no podría sentirme más feliz con la decisión que tomé.

Vine desde México con la ilusión de especializarme en masaje tailandés, y un viaje tan importante merecía encontrar el lugar indicado. Desde el primer día me hicieron sentir bienvenido, como si hubiera llegado a un sitio que ya conocía.

Cada mañana comenzamos con una clase de yoga guiada por alguno de los maestros y, después, cada estudiante se dirige a su sala de estudio con el profesor asignado. Actualmente estoy aquí durante los meses de julio y agosto, una temporada considerada relativamente baja por las lluvias, y aun así la escuela recibe diariamente a una gran cantidad de estudiantes de diferentes partes del mundo.

Más allá de la calidad de la enseñanza, lo que realmente hace especial este lugar es la calidez de las personas que forman parte de él. Se nota el amor y la dedicación con la que comparten este maravilloso arte.

Solo tengo palabras de gratitud. Recomiendo esta escuela con total confianza a cualquier persona que quiera aprender masaje tailandés de manera profesional. Sin duda volveré muchas veces y siempre llevaré este lugar y a sus maestros en mi corazón. 🧡🇹🇭

Gracias gracias gracias ❤️🎓😍
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm currently enrolled in the Teacher Training Program offered by this school, and honestly, I couldn't be happier with my decision.

I came from Mexico with the dream of specializing in Thai massage, and such an important journey deserved to find the right place. From day one, they made me feel welcome, as if I had arrived somewhere I already knew.

Every morning, we start with a yoga class led by one of the teachers, and afterward, each student goes to their studio with their assigned instructor. I'm currently here during July and August, a relatively slow season due to the rains, and yet the school still welcomes a large number of students from all over the world every day.

Beyond the quality of the teaching, what truly makes this place special is the warmth of the people who are part of it. You can feel the love and dedication with which they share this wonderful art.

I have nothing but words of gratitude. I wholeheartedly recommend this school to anyone who wants to learn Thai massage professionally. I will definitely return many times and will always carry this place and its teachers in my heart. 🧡🇹🇭

Thank you, thank you, thank you ❤️🎓😍

I’ve been in Thailand for a month and tried at least 10 different massage places and probably 20 different massage therapists in Bangkok, Phuket and Pattaya. This place was honestly the best experience I had.
The salon is really nice, clean and comfortable, the atmosphere is great, the music and smell are relaxing, and the prices are very reasonable. It’s also super conveniently located, just a short walk from Jomtien Beach and close to everything you might need.
But the main reason I kept coming back was Neung, my massage therapist. I tried a few different places during my trip, but once I found him, I just kept coming back. He has exactly the right balance of pressure and relaxation — strong when needed, but also very smooth and relaxing. Just a really good massage.
Highly recommend Neung and this salon in general. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Pattaya!

reviews.name: Eddie Tan
reviews.text:
This past January, I walked into this shop for the first time and had the incredible luck of being massaged by the owner's mother. I have suffered from lower back pain for nearly 10 years due to my work. Her technique wasn't just amazing; she truly understood how to treat the body holistically as a single, interconnected system. She didn’t just focus on my lower back and legs—she also massaged my abdominal fascia, which finally released years of deep-seated tension and pressure. In February, while traveling in Prague, I caught a chill and my back pain flared up so badly that I couldn't even bend over. All I could think about was how much I wished she was there! I tried a local Thai massage in Prague to help, but it didn't even come close to her level.

Because of that experience, I specifically traveled back to Chiang Mai this August and purposely booked a hotel near this shop just so I could visit daily. Although the mother had recently undergone surgery and was only able to massage me once on this trip, it was still completely worth it. I cannot recommend this place highly enough—it made my entire trip worthwhile. I sincerely wish the owner and her mother the very best of health.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly delighted that you used our services and were impressed. The woman who massaged you, Uiychan, is the same person mentioned in the reviews. I stopped by casually because it was near my accommodation. Normally, my soles hurt quickly after walking just a little, and my big toes are a bit numb... I took the 60-minute foot massage course here, and it felt like the masseuse knew exactly where to hit the pressure points. I got it a week ago and am back in Korea now, but strangely enough, the sole pain I usually have every day has disappeared since the day after the massage, and the sensation in my big toe has improved, so I rushed here to write a Google Maps review haha.

It’s a real shame I couldn't revisit for a full-body massage because I didn't have time...

Oh, and please note that they only accept cash payments, not GLN QR code payments! (As of August 2026, a 60-minute foot massage is 300 baht)

ownerDescription: Sirichan Thai Healing Center offers Thai therapeutic massage training, treatments, and well-being experiences at the Green Oasis Resort in Ton Pao, San Kamphaeng, Chiang Mai. The center teaches authentic Thai therapeutic bodywork in small groups and provides treatments for guests, students, and visitors.
address: 176 หมู่ที่ 8 ถนน สันกำแพงสายใหม่, Ton Pao, San Kamphaeng District, Chiang Mai 50130, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Five weeks. 150 hours.
You begin by learning Thai Massage. Then you add more. More techniques. More positions. Walking Massage. Body Balancing. Bone Setting.
But collecting techniques is not the point of the program.
The interesting part begins when you have enough tools in your hands to stop thinking only about the tool.
By Week 4, you are reinforcing what you have learned, correcting weak points, adding more techniques and beginning to put the different approaches together.
Your attention starts moving away from:
“How do I perform this correctly?”
toward:
“What am I feeling?”
Then comes Week 5.
You begin working with real clients under supervision. And suddenly, the body on the table does not care what was on yesterday’s lesson plan. 
You have to listen. Observe. Choose. Work. Notice the response. And sometimes change direction.
That is the progression of the Sirichan Therapeutic Bodywork Practitioner Program:
The training is shaped by more than 30 years of clinical bodywork practice in Thailand.
It runs only once each year, with a maximum of 12 students.
5 weeks · 150 hours · 39,500 THB at Sirichan Thai Healing Center, Chiang Mai, Thailand.
Curious? 
👆 Explore the full 5-Week Practitioner Program

THE FACE IS NOT A FORMULA.

Chantra, the facial signature of Sirichan Thai Healing Center, is not one routine repeated on every client. You learn to read the face first, then choose the work.

Developed by Dr. Sirichan over 30+ years of clinical practice, Chantra is a complete manual facial treatment for experienced hands-on practitioners who want more precision, sensitivity and adaptability.

What you will learn (5 days)

Facial observation and assessment
Muscle, fingertip, jaw, eye-area and forehead techniques
Neck and shoulder work
Soft-tissue, connective-tissue and lymphatic techniques
Pressure, rhythm, duration and positioning
Complete Chantra treatment practice

The question changes from "What movement comes next?" to "What does this person need here?"

Your eyes assess. Your hands listen. Your technique responds.

How it works
Demonstration, repetition, supervised practice, correction. Maximum 8 students, so everyone gets personal correction.

Who it is for
Massage therapists, facialists, beauticians, spa professionals, bodyworkers. Previous hands-on massage experience is required.

20,000 THB (tuition included) · Maximum 8 students

To apply, email connect@sirichan.org with your full name and your massage/bodywork experience.

You come to learn a technique.
We teach you how to use it.
Looking to deepen your bodywork practice and move beyond basic routines? 
At Sirichan Thai Healing Center, you’ll master more than just movements - you’ll learn how to truly listen and respond to the body. 
Whether you want to specialize in a specific modality or take your skills to a master level, explore our training options:
➡️ Abdominal Massage
➡️ Chantra Face Massage
➡️ Amataros
➡️ Tok Sen
➡️ Herbal Ball Therapy or 
➡️ the full 5-Week Therapeutic Bodywork Practitioner Program
Different courses. 
Same underlying approach.
Technique is only the beginning. You learn it, practice, receive real-time corrections, and practice again. Once the movement becomes second nature, your attention shifts to what truly matters:
✨ What do I actually feel?
✨ How is this area connected to another?
✨ How is the body responding right now?
✨ Should I hold, adjust pressure, shift position, or adapt my technique?
What sets our training apart:
🤲 30+ Years of Clinical Wisdom: Rooted in real therapeutic practice from Thailand. 
🤝 Serious Training: High focus, precise correction, and deep repetition.
🫶 Light Atmosphere: Shared meals, open questions, laughter, receiving treatment, and connecting with a community of passionate practitioners.
If you are ready to step away from simply collecting more certificates and start broadening the way you work, join us in Chiang Mai.
📍 Sirichan Thai Healing Center, San Kamphaeng, Chiang Mai, Thailand

After six years of living in Thailand, I finally found what I had been looking for—and much more. I have had many massages throughout my life, but my experience with Dr. Noi was completely different.

Her treatments combine authentic traditional Thai massage and Thai medicine, taking the whole body into consideration rather than focusing only on individual aches and pains. After just a few sessions, my body felt much more balanced and comfortable.

I especially recommend the abdominal massage and the traditional Thai tools Dr. Noi uses. They helped me feel significant relief in my lower back, neck, joints, and throughout my body. The treatments also helped calm my nervous system and gave me a deep sense of relaxation and well-being.

I am extremely satisfied with Dr. Noi’s holistic and deeply healing approach. I highly recommend her treatments to anyone looking for more than an ordinary massage. This is holistic healing treatment.

What a beautiful and peaceful location! 🌿✨

Highly recommend for any mummas looking to treat themselves to a beautiful, relaxing morning without spending a fortune. It’s perfect if you’re wanting something a little more special and luxurious than the street massage places, while still being really affordable.

We booked from Australia via WhatsApp and arranged a 3-hour package for myself and a friend. From the very beginning, they were so helpful and accommodating, especially as my friend is 4 months pregnant. They made sure she was comfortable and well cared for throughout the whole experience.

We enjoyed a body scrub, massage and facial, and it was honestly just what we needed — three hours of pure relaxation! It definitely lives up to its reputation for being peaceful, relaxing and a little bit special.

Our therapists, Lisa and Tew, were so warm and lovely, and Taew at reception was incredibly friendly and welcoming. We even received a little complimentary gift on our way out, which was such a sweet touch. 🥰

We left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. 💆‍♀️💕

這家位於The Sis Kata裡面，對於住客按摩非常方便。

Located inside The Sis Kata, this place is very convenient for guests to get a massage.

However, it's extremely popular, and there are no walk-in appointments. So I booked a later time, told the front desk I wanted an aromatherapy massage, and paid a deposit.

When I arrived early for my appointment, I discovered the front desk hadn't confirmed my session options with me. They simply selected a 60-minute aromatherapy massage for me, and the only option to change it was to another 60-minute session; the duration couldn't be altered. I felt this was inflexible, and the front desk hadn't fulfilled their responsibility to explain the sessions.

Before the massage, I was asked to shower, but the shower room wasn't very nice (much worse than another chain massage I've had in Phuket). The air conditioning was very cold during the massage, and I could feel the masseuse was rushing the massage; I didn't feel relaxed at all.

The overall atmosphere of the shop was very relaxing, and the aromatherapy oils and products used smelled wonderful and therapeutic. It's a pity the masseuse and front desk staff weren't up to par, despite the high prices—it's one of the most expensive in Phuket.

reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Extremely Disappointing Experience! Terrible Communication and a Serious Safety Concern!

This was honestly one of the worst spa experiences I have ever had!

The staff had ZERO communication skills and showed absolutely no attention to their customer’s needs.

Before the treatment, I clearly informed them that I had an injury on my arm and specifically requested that they focus on my head instead. However, when I entered the treatment room, my instructions were completely ignored. What is the point of asking customers about their concerns if nobody bothers to listen?

To make matters even worse, after the massage ended, the staff did not even turn on the lights, leaving the room dark. As a result, I fell! This is completely unacceptable and raises serious concerns about customer safety.

A spa is supposed to be a place where customers feel relaxed, comfortable, and well taken care of. Instead, I experienced poor communication, careless service, and a complete lack of basic safety precautions.

This is not just bad service — it is irresponsible and potentially dangerous!

I am extremely disappointed and would NOT recommend this spa to anyone, especially those with injuries or special treatment requirements.

Management seriously needs to retrain its staff in communication, customer care, and basic safety procedures.

Absolutely unacceptable. I will never return!

如果身體有點小毛病又不怕痛的

reviews.textTranslated:
Before going abroad, my left arm was only slightly better than level with my shoulder when I raised it. Traditional Chinese medicine said it was due to a cold. I had acupuncture several times, but it didn't help much. Master Fen (PHEN) was very attentive during my first massage, spending a lot of time and effort on my left scapula. The first time was incredibly painful, but after the pain subsided, I felt much better. After more than ten nights of massage from Master Fen, before returning to Taiwan, I could raise my arm to touch my ear. Although it was still sore and tight, the improvement was tremendous.

Meeting Master Fen was my luck. When I left, I translated my words of gratitude onto my phone and showed them to him. He said it was his job. Master Fen isn't the overly friendly type, but he's very dedicated to his work and capable. Regarding my ailment, I know not every masseur will go to such lengths.

Most masseuses, when they know you have discomfort, simply follow the procedure or gloss over it. Some will try, but that depends heavily on individual skill. I've had two really good ones before, but when I went back, they were no longer at their original massage parlors. So, if you find a good masseur, cherish the moment.

It seems like Master Fen only comes to help out when there are many customers. I don't know why he was at the shop the first time we met, because afterwards I always made appointments directly with him, and he would only arrive on his scooter at the agreed time. If you have minor health issues and aren't afraid of pain, you might want to try Master Fen.

reviews.name: おんちゃん
reviews.text:
I completed the Basic Thai Massage and Thai Oil Massage courses. The school is located in a very safe area, and the accommodation next to the school was only a one-minute walk away. There were also plenty of restaurants and a local market nearby, so I never had any trouble finding food or shopping for daily necessities.

This was my fourth massage school in Chiang Mai, and personally, CNF was the best one I have attended.

Napa and Beam are incredibly kind teachers, and their classes are thorough and easy to follow. I learned far more than just the techniques in the textbook, as they shared many valuable insights and practical skills from their experience. They were also always willing to answer questions in detail.

reviews.textTranslated:
This time I had a foot massage. The masseuse was very skilled, the pressure was great, and the acupressure was very effective in relieving soreness.

Unfortunately, I only found this place on my last day in Bangkok. I'll definitely visit again next time!

P.S. The male masseuse I met this time spoke Chinese, so communication was very smooth.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

能在您離開曼谷前為您帶來一次愉快的按摩體驗，是我們的榮幸。也非常感謝您特別提到中文溝通的部分，能讓您在按摩過程中感到輕鬆自在，是我們非常重視的。

reviews.name: Huisu Jeong
reviews.text:
이 리뷰는 절대 비방 목적이 아닙니다.
이집은 곡괭이 마스터입니다.
15년동안 여행하면서 받아 본 여러 나라 마사지 중에 이집이 제일 강력했습니다.
평소에 아플 정도로 강한 마사지를 선호하는데.
여기는 아프다고 얘기 안하면 비명 지르기 직전까지 강하게 눌러주십니다. 중간중간에 괜찮냐고 계속 확인차 물어보십니다.
후회 안합니다. 꼭 오세요. 두번 받으세요.
reviews.textTranslated:
This review is absolutely not intended to be a slander.

This place is a master of the pickaxe.

Of all the massages I've received in various countries during my 15 years of traveling, this place was the most powerful.

I usually prefer massages that are strong enough to be painful.

Here, unless you say it hurts, they press hard enough to make you scream. They keep checking in periodically to see if you're okay.

You won't regret it. You must come. Get it twice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
소중한 리뷰를 남겨주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다.

15년 동안 여러 나라에서 다양한 마사지를 경험하신 고객님께서 저희 마사지를 특별하게 기억해 주셨다니 정말 기쁩니다. 😊

강한 마사지를 선호하시는 고객님의 취향에 맞춰 만족스러운 경험을 드릴 수 있었던 것 같아 저희도 보람을 느낍니다. 무엇보다 마사지 중간중간 고객님의 상태와 압력이 괜찮은지 확인하는 것은 저희가 중요하게 생각하는 부분입니다.

재미있고 유쾌한 표현으로 남겨주신 리뷰 덕분에 저희 직원들도 큰 힘을 얻을 것 같습니다. 😄

다음 방문에도 만족하실 수 있도록 정성껏 모시겠습니다.
다시 찾아주셔서 두 번, 세 번이라도 편안하고 좋은 시간 보내실 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.

감사합니다! 🙏

reviews.text:
I came here twice and absolutely loved it. I prefer deep tissue massages, and after visiting this place, I realized I didn’t really know what a deep tissue massage was before! 😄

The first evening, I chose the option that included a leg massage. My therapist was a woman, and she did an excellent job, that’s why I came back next day.

On my second visit, I had a shoulder and neck massage combined with a full-body Thai massage. My therapist was Mr. Kyu, and I highly recommend him. He was very professional, worked very precisely, and used just the right amount of pressure to really work through every muscle.

The place itself is very simple and unpretentious, but everything is clean and well-kept. It’s also an excellent value for money.

If you need to work out serious tension and tightness, I highly recommend asking to book a session with Mr. Kyu.

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

วันนี้ฉันมาทำเล็บมือ เล็บเท้า และตัดผมที่ร้านนี้ รู้สึกประทับใจมากค่ะ

บรรยากาศในร้านสะอาด สวยงาม และอบอุ่นมาก

reviews.text:
お店がカオサンの中心にあった時（2009年）に一人旅で初来訪。値段の割には技術が素晴らしく丁寧だったので、翌年も複数回行きました。

その10年後に行ったところ、移転をしており移転先に行きましたが、時間外なのか閉店していました。

また旅行の際はお世話になりたいマッサージ店です。
reviews.textTranslated:
I first visited this massage parlor on a solo trip in 2009, when it was located in the heart of Khao San Road. The technique was excellent and the service was so thorough, especially considering the price, that I went back several times the following year.

Ten years later, I went again, but they had moved. I went to the new location, but it was closed, perhaps because it was outside of business hours.

It's a massage parlor I'd like to visit again on my next trip.

reviews.name: BlueLite
reviews.text: The ambience is great even though the spa was really unassuming both inside and outside. The music and medicinal smell is just fantastic! ownerDescription:
Thai massage is a form of bodywork that originated in Thailand.
A foot massage is used on the muscles located around the front and back of the feet. Techniques such as acupressure, frictions, skin rolling and trigger pointing are used to help treat acute pain, post injury, post-surgery and scarring.
An aromatherapy massage is a type of massage therapy that uses essential oils to promote relaxation and well-being.
Body scrub at a massage parlor is a rejuvenating treatment that gently exfoliates your skin, removing dead skin cells and impurities.
A face beauty treatment that cleans and improves your skin tone and texture with the use of foam ,scrub,lotions,masks and massage therapy.
Pedicure and manicure are scrub, cut and colors.

reviews.textTranslated:
I went for my first facial massage. It was a full 2 ​​hours with Khun Poy (the masseuse/owner of the place/my girlfriend, lol). The massage was amazing, she didn't hold anything back, and explained many details. The massage was at Khun Poy's house, which was incredibly clean (a million times cleaner!). The place felt very safe; it was just Khun Poy and me. It was also conveniently located. During the massage, I was so relaxed I almost fell asleep, but I tried to stay awake to fully absorb the feeling, lol.
After the massage, my cheeks were lifted, really lifted! My eyebrows were lifted too. It wasn't painful, just a little tight. My face felt so light. You might not see results on the first try, but it's best to do it gradually. I didn't dare use needles. It was such a good decision to come, I'm glad I did. I really didn't want to write a review because I was afraid of getting too many clients, lol.

I'll definitely be a regular customer! ❤️😊🥰

reviews.name: Sasilak Piyasuwan
reviews.text:
เป็นครั้งแรกที่ได้เปิดประสบการณ์การนวดหน้าจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญแบบคุณปอย ประทับใจตั้งแต่การรับนัดจัดคิว การส่งรายละเอียดต่างๆ ทั้งเรื่องนวด และเส้นทางการมาที่คอนโด

แม้ว่าจะไม่มีหน้าร้าน และแอบตื่นเต้นนิดๆ กับการไปรับบริการที่ห้อง แต่ทุกความกังวลก็หายไป นอกจากการจัดห้องได้น่ารักมากแล้ว ยังได้รับการเอาใจใส่ในทุกสิ่งอย่างที่คุณปอยตั้งใจให้บริการ ระหว่างการนวดรู้สึกสบายใบหน้ามาก หลังจากนวดแล้วไม่มีความผิดปกติใดใด ไว้จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time experiencing a professional facial massage like Ploy's. I was impressed from the moment I made the appointment, from scheduling to receiving detailed information about the massage and directions to her condo.

Even though she doesn't have a physical shop and I was a little nervous about receiving the service at her place, all my worries disappeared. Not only was the room beautifully decorated, but Ploy also showed me incredible attention to detail in every aspect of her service. During the massage, my face felt incredibly relaxed, and there were no noticeable problems afterward. I will definitely be back for more services.

reviews.name: Nu Gussy
reviews.text: เป็นครั้งแรกที่เปิดประสบการณ์การนวดหน้า ประทับใจมากๆ เราเลือกนวดแบบศาสตร์หัตถดาบส นวดสปายกกระชับปรับรูปหน้า อย่างแรกคือก้าวเข้าห้องไปคือห้องสวยมาก หอมสุด (ใจอยากถามเลยค่ะใช้กลิ่นอะไรค่ะ) คุณปอยก้ออธิบายแนะนำได้ดีมากๆ พอนวดแล้วรู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากๆ สบายหน้า สบายหัว นวดจนเราหลับไปเลย หลังนวดรู้สึกโล่งสบาย ต้องมีครั้งต่อๆไปแน่นอนค่ะ

I chose the traditional Thai massage technique, a spa massage for lifting and contouring the face. During the massage, I felt incredibly relaxed; my face and head felt so good, I even fell asleep! I felt so refreshed and relaxed afterwards. I'll definitely be back for more!

reviews.name: Emilie Demarly
reviews.text:
Expérience un peu étrange. Nous ne pouvons pas juger de la qualité du massage car nous ne sommes pas des expertes en massage thaïlandais. Néanmoins, nous avons été surprises par l’ambiance générale peu apaisante (parlent entre elles, musique basse et lumière allumée). Les masseuses se sont notamment absentées à plusieurs reprises - l’une a même tiré la chasse d’eau juste avant de revenir me masser…
Globalement, les masseuses n’étaient pas très à l’écoute. Cela n’a pas été un moment relaxant du tout. À vous de vous faire votre avis.
reviews.textTranslated:
A somewhat strange experience. We can't judge the quality of the massage as we're not experts in Thai massage. However, we were surprised by the generally unsettling atmosphere (they were talking amongst themselves, the music was low, and the lights were on). The masseuses were absent several times – one even flushed the toilet just before returning to massage me…
Overall, the masseuses weren't very attentive. It wasn't a relaxing experience at all. Make up your own mind.

reviews.name: Isabelle aimar
reviews.text: Massage exceptionnel!!!!! Fantastique! Accueil parfait! Le bonheur ❤️❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated: Exceptional massage! Fantastic! Perfect welcome! Bliss ❤️❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Isabelle,

Pure happiness? That's great 😀
We just tried to untangle your muscles, but we will gladly take "le bonheur" as a side effect!

Thanks for the love, and see you next time at Somphet Massage. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Bobbi Kraham
reviews.text: A terrible experience from start to finish. The worst massage I had in Thailand. Look elsewhere if you want a private relaxing massage. I cut my massage short and could not get out of there fast enough. There is not enough space around the massage table for the therapist to move around so the curtains were constantly  being opened and closed and flapping against different parts of my body. At one point, the curtains were fully opened and I was completely exposed from the waist up to a man who was standing there waiting for a massage. They put him on the other side of my curtain so I had to walk through his space when he was exposed as I departed. Extremely unprofessional and I left far more tense than I started.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Bobbi,

You are completely right, and we owe you a sincere apology. You came to us to relax, and instead, you left feeling stressed and uncomfortable. That is entirely on us.

We usually pride ourselves on providing a peaceful, highly private environment, but we clearly dropped the ball during your visit. Your privacy and comfort should be an absolute guarantee, and we are so sorry that our poor space management made you feel exposed and forced you to cut your time short.

Thank you for your blunt honesty. It was a tough read, but a necessary wake-up call. We have already adjusted our setup and reviewed our privacy protocols with the entire team to ensure our space is managed with the respect and care our guests deserve.

I hope you will come back to see, that we already fixed it.

We are truly sorry we let you down this time, but we appreciate you helping Somphet Massage do better. 🙏

reviews.name: ดวงใจ แซ่ยั้ง
reviews.text: นวดดีจริงๆ คุ้มมากแนะนำ
reviews.textTranslated: The massage was really good. Definitely worth it. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Duangjai,

Thank you for the fantastic review! We firmly believe that a great massage shouldn't cost you an arm and a leg, mostly because our therapists need your arms and legs intact to actually massage them.

We are thrilled you felt you got great value and left completely relaxed. Whenever you are back in the Old City and need another proper muscle fix without emptying your wallet, the team at Somphet Massage is ready for you! 🙏😀

reviews.name: Jae Oli
reviews.text: 리뷰보고 속았다… 비수기라 마사지하는 분이 잘못 걸린건지…. 저는 너무 스킬없고 그냥 여기 저기 막 힘으로만 눌러서 아프고 별로였네요. 원래 잘하는 곳 같은데 아쉽네여
reviews.textTranslated: I feel like I was fooled by the reviews... Maybe I got the wrong masseuse because it's the off-season... She was so unskilled and just pressed hard here and there, which hurt and wasn't good at all. It seems like a place that's usually good, so it's a shame.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jae,

Thank you for sharing your opinion. 

Please be aware that some people like the massage harder, some softer. If it feels too hard, every massage therapist can adjust the level immediately. You just have to tell them what you like and what you don't like.

I will talk to all my therapists and tell them to ask more often if the pressure is too hard or too soft.

Thank you for your feedback. 🙏

力道小，也按不到點

reviews.textTranslated:
The pressure was too weak and didn't press the right spots.

Very disappointed.
Although the owner was very honest,

the staff's skill level is questionable.

Initially, I felt it wasn't suitable and asked to change the masseur. The shop responded that I needed a masseur with stronger pressure, but that would cost extra.

This seemed unreasonable, as nearby shops have better staff and don't require extra payment.

Even after changing masseuses, the pressure was still insufficient.

I feel like I wasted two hours and money. I will never patronize this shop again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We always do our utmost to ensure our customers are satisfied. When we learned that you were unhappy with the service, we took steps to address your concerns by changing the staff member serving you in the hope of improving your experience.

Our staff also made every effort to provide the best possible service. While we understand that not every experience may meet a customer’s expectations, we hope that the efforts made by both our management and staff will also be taken into consideration.

We value all feedback and will continue to improve our service. Thank you for sharing your experience.

reviews.name: Ada Lee
reviews.text:
Fikk time dagen etter fordi jeg og reisefølget ville ta negler samtidig. Vi fikk en kopp te og en liten kake pakket i plast. Alt var veldig hygienisk, og det virket som at de vasket utstyret mellom hver kunde. De var dyktige og resultatet ble veldig fint. Jeg fikk korte forlengelser med pvc (en plasttupp de limer på) og reisefølget mitt tok forlengelse med gel. Begge ble veldig fine, gel var 600 baht dyrere.
Pris til sammen med negdesign ble 1800 og 2400 baht for henholdsvis pvc og gel. Resultatet ble veldig bra, så det var verdt prisen, selvom vi ble litt overrasket da vi kom til kassa! Vi startet rundt 16 og begge var ferdig før 19, litt lang tid, men sånn er det når du vil ha et godt resultat<3
reviews.textTranslated:
I got an appointment the next day because my travel companion and I wanted to get our nails done at the same time. We got a cup of tea and a small cake wrapped in plastic. Everything was very hygienic, and it seemed like they washed the equipment between each customer. They were skilled and the result was very nice. I got short extensions with PVC (a plastic tip they glue on) and my travel companion got extensions with gel. Both were very nice, gel was 600 baht more expensive.
The price together with negdedesign was 1800 and 2400 baht for PVC and gel respectively. The result was very good, so it was worth the price, although we were a little surprised when we got to the checkout! We started around 4 pm and both were finished before 7 pm, a bit long, but that's how it is when you want a good result <3
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ada,  
Thank you so much for your 5-star review and for visiting us with your friend 💅✨

We’re so glad you enjoyed the tea and cake, and that you felt our salon is clean and hygienic. Our team always sterilizes all tools between customers to keep everything safe for you.

We’re also happy to hear you both loved your nails! PVC extensions and gel extensions both look beautiful, and thank you for understanding that gel is a bit more expensive due to the materials and time.

We’re sorry if the price was a little surprising at checkout. We always aim to give the best quality and results that are worth it. And yes, good nails do take time 
We can’t wait to welcome you both back again.🥰

With love,  
LP Team

reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with the facial cleansing treatment.

I came with my boyfriend and paid 1,600 baht for two people. Unfortunately, the treatment was not worth the money at all.

They used some hard tools on our faces, but they didn’t actually extract anything. My blackheads are still exactly where they were before the treatment. The head massage was also included in the treatment list, but we didn’t get one.

They basically just applied some masks, which is something I could easily do at home myself.

I definitely do not recommend this clinic for facial cleansing. I expected proper pore cleaning and extractions, but unfortunately, I saw no real result.

Делала движения как попало: то шею, то плечи, то снова шею, то плечи и повторяла одни и те же движения. Было ощущение, что она не знает, как массажировать и просто делает какие-то движения руками. После массажа у меня раздражена кожа головы и очень чешется. Я пришла сюда на массаж головы и лица, потому что была на их массаже ног и они делали его хорошо. reviews.textTranslated: I had a terrible facial and scalp massage. The masseuse didn't even wash her hands before the facial massage; she kept warming the same spot on my head, which is hard to call a massage. She moved haphazardly: first my neck, then my shoulders, then my neck again, then my shoulders, repeating the same movements over and over. It felt like she didn't know how to massage and was just moving her hands around. After the massage, my scalp was irritated and very itchy. I came here for a scalp and facial massage because I'd had their foot massage, and they did a good job. They said they'd do a good job on my head and face too, but it was terrible!!! And the masseuse's nails weren't trimmed; she kept nicking me with her long nails and scratching my skin. I really regret wasting almost an hour and getting irritation and disappointment instead of pleasure!

reviews.name: Светлана Светуля
reviews.text: Посетили этот салон, ориентируясь на высокий рейтинг, но столкнулись с обманом! Как только выбрали какой массаж нужен, сразу подвели к кассе, что бы мы оплатили заранее, первый раз такое встречаю (обычно услугу оплачивают после)! Ну да, ладно, оплатили. Но потом все стало ясно, у меня был массаж ног, массажистка еле-еле касалась, совсем было не похоже на массаж, когда я ей сказала об этом (через переводчика) она сказала, что "стронг" массаж надо доплачивать. В прайсе у них нет такой информации, деления на софт, стронг. Муж делал тайский массаж, выскочил через 5 минут после начала, массажистка включила кондиционер прям на него направленный, он попросил закрыть штору, а она ее опять открыла, вообще он попросил остановить процедуру. Видимо такая практика у них, не про массаж! , главное деньги у туристов взять. Не рекомендую никому, вокруг полно других салонов
reviews.textTranslated: We visited this salon, relying on its high ratings, but were scammed! As soon as we chose the massage we wanted, we were immediately taken to the cashier to pay in advance. This is the first time I've encountered this (usually you pay for the service afterward). Oh well, we paid. But then everything became clear. I had a foot massage, and the masseuse barely touched me; it didn't feel like a massage at all. When I told her about it (through a translator), she said you have to pay extra for a "strong" massage. Their price list doesn't list this information, or differentiate between soft and strong. My husband was getting a Thai massage and left five minutes after it started. The masseuse turned on the air conditioning aimed directly at him. He asked her to close the curtain, but she opened it again. He even asked her to stop the procedure. Apparently, this is their practice; it's not about massages! The main thing is to take money from tourists. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone; there are plenty of other salons around.
