reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet your expectations. At SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa, we take every concern seriously and would like to respectfully clarify a few important points.

Regarding your prenatal massage:

The safety and well-being of both mother and baby are always our highest priorities.

Our therapists receive specialized training in prenatal massage, including appropriate side-lying positioning, proper body support, and techniques specifically adapted for expectant mothers.

Unlike a regular massage, prenatal massage requires additional precautions, particularly during the later stages of pregnancy. Our therapists therefore carefully adjust the pressure and techniques to prioritize comfort and safety rather than applying the same deep pressure used in a standard massage.

We would like to reassure you that this gentle approach reflects our commitment to responsible prenatal care, not a lack of professional training or massage techniques.

Regarding our pricing policy:

We would also like to clarify that SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa maintains the same standard prices for all guests, regardless of nationality.

We do not practice nationality-based pricing or discrimination of any kind.

Our only discounted rates are offered through prepaid membership packages, which are equally available to both Thai and international guests. Any difference in pricing is based solely on membership benefits, never on nationality.

We sincerely apologize if this policy was not clearly communicated.

Regarding our hospitality and communication:

Our team receives training in professional hospitality, service etiquette, and customer care. Every guest deserves to be treated with kindness, respect, and equal attention.

We acknowledge that our team’s English communication may not always be perfect, and we sincerely apologize for any difficulties this may have caused. Nevertheless, our staff are genuinely committed to providing attentive and respectful service to every guest.

At SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa, we believe that true professionalism means not only providing a relaxing experience, but also knowing when to adapt a treatment to protect our guests’ well-being.

We value your feedback and will continue improving our communication and service standards. We also hope this clarification provides a better understanding of our prenatal massage practices and our commitment to fair and transparent pricing.

Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to address your concerns.

Warm regards,
Management Team
SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text:
最一開始知道這家按摩店，是因為看到很多人推薦，雖然從飯店走過來大概要 20 分鐘，但還是想說來體驗看看。

第一次做的是泰式按摩，在清邁每天爆走一萬步，Aum 按一按發現我有些部位比較緊繃，後來還幫我加了 Tok Sen。原本只打算按一小時，最後直接加到 90 分鐘🤣

Aum 按摩的方式不是完全照固定流程走，而是會一直觀察身體哪裡比較緊、哪裡需要多處理一點。
他很會找到痠痛的地方，不是那種為了按到痠而一直硬按，而是會找到痠痛點之後慢慢處理，有一種痠爽的感覺。

Tok Sen 也是這次很意外的收穫，敲下去的震動和頻率很舒服，對緊繃的肌肉滿有幫助。

Aum 很真誠，也完全不會敷衍了事，有一次幫我做蘭納療法的繩索治療時，還一邊幫我按摩其他地方，整個過程都會一直注意身體其他部位的狀況。

如果你想針對痠痛部位加強處理，很推薦來一趟。Aum 牆上有超級多專業證書，收費也很平價～

另外偷偷說一下，Aum 說想讓更多人認識 Tok Sen！如果是看到這篇評論、第一次跟 Aum 預約的客人，可以在預約時跟 Aum 提一下。當天如果時間允許，Aum 會視情況讓你體驗大約 5～10 分鐘的 Tok Sen。

總之，這家按摩店雖然離老城區有一點距離，但是很值得來！按摩完還可以順便吃對面的清真菜，乾淨又好吃～
reviews.textTranslated:
I initially learned about this massage parlor from many recommendations. Although it's about a 20-minute walk from my hotel, I still wanted to try it out.

My first massage was Thai. Having walked 10,000 steps a day in Chiang Mai, Aum noticed some tension in certain areas and added a Tok Sen treatment. Originally, I only planned for an hour, but it ended up being 90 minutes! 🤣

Aum's massage method isn't strictly following a fixed routine. He constantly observes where my body is tight and what needs more attention.

He's very good at finding sore spots, not by pressing relentlessly to induce soreness, but by gently addressing the sore points, creating a pleasant, tingling sensation.

The Tok Sen treatment was an unexpected bonus. The vibrations and frequency were very comfortable and helpful for tight muscles.

Aum is very sincere and doesn't just rush through things. Once, while doing a Lanna therapy rope treatment, he also massaged other parts of my body, constantly paying attention to the condition of other areas throughout the entire process.

If you're looking for intensive treatment on sore areas, I highly recommend a visit. Aum has tons of professional certificates on the wall, and the prices are very reasonable.

Also, just between you and me, Aum wants more people to know about Tok Sen! If you're seeing this review and booking your first time with Aum, you can mention it when you make your appointment. If time allows, Aum will give you a 5-10 minute Tok Sen experience.

In short, although this massage parlor is a bit far from the old town, it's definitely worth a visit! After your massage, you can grab a bite at the halal restaurant across the street—clean and delicious!

Whether you need to unwind after a long work week or want serious skin results, I cannot recommend them enough. You’ll be in fantastic hands!

reviews.name: T Z
reviews.text: Ich komme jedes Mal nach Thailand und lasse mich fast täglich mindestens zwei Stunden lang mit Öl massieren. Aber so eine schlechte Massage habe ich in Thailand wirklich noch nie erlebt.Ich habe die Masseurin mehrmals ausdrücklich darum gebeten, etwas kräftiger zu massieren. Sie sagte jedoch, dass sie nicht stärker drücken könne. Ich kann mir ehrlich gesagt überhaupt nicht vorstellen, was das für eine Massage sein sollte. Es war praktisch keinerlei Druck vorhanden.Stattdessen wurde ständig sehr viel Öl auf meinen Körper geschüttet und dann mit sehr schnellen Bewegungen einfach über die Haut gerieben. Es fühlte sich eher so an, als würde jemand meinen Körper mit Duschgel waschen, anstatt ihn zu massieren. Die Finger hatten überhaupt keine Kraft und es gab keinerlei Tiefenwirkung.Von Entspannung konnte überhaupt keine Rede sein – weder körperlich noch mental. Im Gegenteil, die ganze Behandlung war für mich einfach nur unangenehm.Dazu kommt, dass der Preis hier sogar höher ist als bei vielen anderen Massagegeschäften. Für den höheren Preis habe ich leider eine extrem schlechte Massage bekommen.Eigentlich wollte ich zu Cattleya Massage Rama 9 gehen. Da es dort um 23:00 Uhr schließt und ich keine Zeit mehr für eine zweistündige Massage hatte, habe ich mich stattdessen für dieses Massagegeschäft entschieden, weil es sehr nah an meinem Hotel liegt.Ich habe der Masseurin sogar vorher gesagt, dass ich gerne zwei Stunden bleiben würde, wenn die Massage gut ist. Aber leider war die Massage so schlecht, dass ich eine derart schlechte Behandlung noch nie erlebt habe. Für mich hatte das überhaupt nichts mit professioneller Massagetechnik zu tun.Ich habe deshalb schon nach weniger als einer Stunde abgebrochen.Wenn ihr wirklich eine gute Massage genießen möchtet, würde ich Cattleya Massage Rama 9 empfehlen. Dort sind die Preise sogar etwas günstiger, aber die Massage ist qualitativ um Welten besser und man bekommt eine wirklich angenehme Behandlung.Bitte lasst euch nicht allein von der schönen Einrichtung bzw. dem schönen Ambiente täuschen. Für mich wäre diese Massage nicht einmal 300 Baht wert.Einfach viel zu schlecht.👎
reviews.textTranslated: I come to Thailand every time and get an oil massage almost every day, at least two hours long. But I've truly never experienced such a bad massage in Thailand. I explicitly asked the masseuse several times to apply more pressure. However, she said she couldn't press any harder. Honestly, I can't imagine what kind of massage that was supposed to be. There was practically no pressure at all. Instead, large amounts of oil were constantly poured onto my body and then simply rubbed over my skin with very quick movements. It felt more like someone was washing my body with shower gel than massaging it. The fingers had absolutely no strength, and there was no deep tissue work. There was no relaxation whatsoever – neither physical nor mental. On the contrary, the entire treatment was simply unpleasant for me. On top of that, the price here is even higher than at many other massage parlors. For that higher price, I unfortunately received an extremely bad massage. I had actually wanted to go to Cattleya Massage Rama 9. Since it closes at 11:00 PM and I didn't have time for a two-hour massage, I chose this massage parlor instead because it's very close to my hotel. I even told the masseuse beforehand that I'd be happy to stay for two hours if the massage was good. But unfortunately, the massage was so bad that I've never experienced such poor treatment. It had absolutely nothing to do with professional massage techniques. I therefore stopped after less than an hour. If you really want to enjoy a good massage, I would recommend Cattleya Massage Rama 9. The prices there are even a bit cheaper, but the quality of the massage is worlds better, and you receive a truly pleasant treatment. Please don't be fooled by the beautiful decor or the nice atmosphere. For me, this massage wouldn't even be worth 300 baht. Simply far too bad. 👎

She was very professional, friendly, and excellent at what she does. Both massages were fantastic and I left feeling incredibly relaxed. Highly recommend!

reviews.textTranslated: I booked a one-hour Thai massage. The masseur was about to wash my feet, but I said, "Oh, I just finished a massage at the shop next door, you don't need to wash my feet." The masseur started to look annoyed, or maybe he overheard me telling the counter staff that I wanted a male masseur because he offered it, as I prefer a strong massage. I changed into his clothes, and the small male masseur wore a smartwatch (the screen lit up when there was a message) and headphones. He asked if I was ready. I replied, "No, I'm not." He then pressed hard on both soles of my feet—I could tolerate it. Then he pressed on my calves. I said it hurt, and he seemed to lighten the pressure a little, but then he pressed again, focusing on my big toes, which was already painful, especially when my skin was pressed against the massage mat. Then he changed the pressure to his palms. I told him that felt good. After a while, he massaged my thighs and elbows, focusing on my elbows. I told him again that it hurt and asked him to be gentler, but it didn't seem to work. I endured it until he finished massaging my legs and arms. When he massaged my palms, he scratched them with his fingernails. I didn't say anything; I just looked at my hands. They were red and had nail marks. I endured it a little longer until he told me to turn over. I told him I was done. He didn't say a word and just walked away. After I went to the restroom, I noticed my palms were marked and stinging. The masseuse had a terrible attitude. She was thin, dressed in black, and appeared to be a trans woman. I informed the cashier before leaving the shop about the reason I didn't get a full hour of massage.

reviews.text:
I chose this place based on chat gpt recommendation, but unfortunately my experience was very disappointing.

I booked a 2-hour foot massage, and throughout the session, the therapist’s nails were actually hurting me. When I mentioned it, instead of addressing the issue professionally, she laughed about it with the other staff and then continued in the same way, which felt quite disrespectful.

For the price they charge—similar to places like Pradara, the experience is significantly worse. At Pradara, for example, the service feels much more thoughtful and professional (they even offer tea at the end), which highlights the difference even more.

Also, basic comfort is lacking—many of the chairs don’t recline properly, which makes a long massage quite uncomfortable.

Overall, I found the reviews misleading and wouldn’t return.

reviews.name: Harald Edvard Ziel Opsvik
reviews.text:
Excellent traditional Thai massage – highly recommended!

I had a wonderful experience at Tuang Thong Massage. This is exactly the kind of place I was looking for: authentic, simple, professional, and completely free from any nonsense.

The therapist was strong, skilled, and clearly very experienced. She gave me a powerful and thorough traditional Thai massage and did an excellent job of working on the stiff areas in my body. She also gave me some very useful advice on how I can reduce stiffness and improve my mobility on my own.

I really appreciated the genuine Thai atmosphere. The place is simple and traditional, with fans instead of air conditioning, which made the experience feel even more authentic and relaxing.

Excellent quality, friendly service, and very good value for money. I would recommend Tuang Thong Massage without hesitation and will definitely return. A truly outstanding traditional Thai massage experience!

reviews.text:
Conveniently located next to the Shangri-La hotel. The inside is very clean and modern. Prices are higher than average, probably due to being located next to the Shangri-La. They do stay open later than most places so if you're looking for something later at night, this is a good option at a slight premium.

You can book online, but we walked in at around 9pm for a 30 minute foot massage and we were the only ones (low season). I think we paid 350 for 30 minutes, but the 60 minute foot massage is 490 baht. Still cheaper than the Shangri-La.

reviews.name: YoungWoo Kim
reviews.text:
어머니와 둘이서 샹그릴라에 숙박하여 가까운곳이라 한번 예약해서 경험했습니다 .

한국어 가능하신 두분이 계세요, 남자는 포/여자는 미소라는 분인데.. 정말 잘하십니다 . 어머니는 아난타라 스파보다 훨씬 좋다고하셔서 연속으로 3일 갔습니다 ㅎㅎ

덕분이 저도 3번을 받았고, 아마 평점이 안좋은 분들은 상주하고있는 두분 말고 콜 테라피스트한테 받으신것같아요.

참고로 미소님은 건식 마사지 정말 잘하시소, 스트레칭 짱입니다 ㅎ 남자분인 포는 스톤/아로마에 탁월합니다.

두분다 한국말 잘 하셔서 어른분들이 가시기에도 불편하지않을것같어요. 꼭 지정하셔서 받아보세요, 깨끗하고 깔끔합니다
reviews.textTranslated:
My mother and I stayed at the Shangri-La, so since this place was nearby, I made a reservation to experience it.

There are two therapists who speak Korean: a male named Pho and a female named Miso. They are truly excellent. My mother said it was much better than the Anantara Spa, so she went for three consecutive days.

Thanks to them, I also received treatments three times. It seems that those with lower ratings likely received treatment from a call therapist instead of the two resident therapists.

For reference, Miso is really good at dry massages, and her stretching is amazing. Pho, the male therapist, is outstanding at hot stones and aromatherapy.

Since both of them speak Korean well, I don't think it would be uncomfortable for elderly visitors. Be sure to request them specifically; it is clean and tidy.

reviews.name: Olga Ryzhkova
reviews.text:
Всем отдыхающим и предвкушении отдыха, добрый день!
Мы с мужем отдыхали на острове в феврале 2026 года, и хотим поделиться впечатлениями о самом лучшем массажном салоне в этом районе. Девушки-массажистки – настоящие профессионалы своего дела.

Я всегда активно занимаюсь спортом: плаваю, хожу в тренажёрный зал, бегаю лёгкой атлетикой. Но офисная сидячая работа привела к постоянному напряжению в трапециевидной мышце. В России делала общий массаж, но эффекта хватало ненадолго, особенно сложно было проработать глубокие слои мышц.

Этот салон мы регулярно посещаем каждое наше посещение острова. Этот отпуск тоже не прошёл без визита к нашим любимым золотым ручкам. Нас сразу же узнали, что было невероятно приятно! Сначала выбрали традиционный тайский массаж. Когда мастер стала разминать тело, тут же заметила проблему с моей спиной и предложила заняться ею отдельно. Она уверенно ответила на мой вопрос: «Ты сможешь помочь?» – конечно, да! И вот уже две недели подряд я ходила на процедуры каждые два дня. За это время мои мышцы были настолько глубоко и качественно размассированы, что ощущения свежести сохранятся до следующей встречи с этими волшебницами.

Эти девушки – настоящие бриллианты среди мастеров массажа. Они внимательно выслушивают ваши жалобы и предлагают оптимальное решение. Поэтому не бойтесь говорить о своих проблемах – они точно знают, как вам помочь. Однозначно рекомендую этот салон на 1000%!
reviews.textTranslated:
Hello to all vacationers looking forward to your vacation!
My husband and I vacationed on the island in February 2026 and would like to share our impressions of the best massage parlor in the area. The masseuses are true professionals.

I've always been active in sports: I swim, go to the gym, and run track and field. But my sedentary office job led to constant tension in my trapezius muscle. I had a full-body massage in Russia, but the effect didn't last long; it was especially difficult to work the deep layers of the muscle.

We regularly visit this parlor every time we visit the island. This vacation also wasn't complete without a visit to our beloved golden hands. They recognized us right away, which was incredibly pleasant! We first chose a traditional Thai massage. As the massage therapist began kneading my body, she immediately noticed a problem with my back and suggested that I work on it separately. She confidently answered my question: "Can you help?" – of course! And for two weeks now, I've been going for treatments every other day. During this time, my muscles have been so deeply and thoroughly massaged that the feeling of freshness will linger until my next appointment with these magicians.

These ladies are true gems among massage therapists. They listen attentively to your concerns and offer the best possible solution. So don't be afraid to talk about your problems – they know exactly how to help you. I definitely recommend this salon 1000%!

reviews.text: I’ve been here many times and always had the best massage, but unfortunately today I had a bad experience with the masseur. Starting with her angry look, the way she ignored twice what I asked for and she was looking at the clock all the time. In the end when she did a head massage she made it very angry, it was very unpleasant experience. Unfortunately I don’t know her name. My mom otherwise had a very good masseur, thanks to her, she was kind and pleasant
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback, and we sincerely apologize for your experience today. As a returning customer, we’re especially sorry that the service did not meet the standard you’ve experienced with us before.
We take your comments regarding the therapist’s attitude, communication, and attention during the massage very seriously. We will review this with our team and provide further training to ensure this does not happen again.
We’re also glad to hear that your mother had a pleasant experience with her therapist. We truly appreciate your continued support and hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a much better experience next time.

reviews.name: Cierra
reviews.text:
I sprained my ankle and had to cancel my trip to Krabi, so what did I decide to do instead? Get a neck, shoulder, and hands massage here. I’m so happy I did.

The massage itself was incredible; not only do they massage your neck, shoulders, and hands, but they also give you an amazing head massage. A nice bonus. It was so relaxing, the pressure was perfect, and the place smelled of fresh laundry. The chairs are so comfortable, and there was peaceful piano music playing. Such a peaceful ambiance.

But what makes this massage parlor really stand out is the people working there.

While I was waiting for my Grab, it started raining hard. One lady—I believe she is the owner—wrapped my ankle splint in three layers of plastic so it wouldn’t get wet. Then, when my Grab arrived, she took off her shoes, grabbed an umbrella, and literally personally escorted me—barefoot—to my Grab car.

I will definitely be back not just for the amazing ambiance and incredible massage, but also for the incredibly kind people who make the place what it is. Thank you for sharing your kindness with me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Cierra, for your incredibly kind and thoughtful review. We're so happy you enjoyed. Your massage and cared during your visit at OHH MASSAGE. It truly meant a lot to us to be help. We hope your ankle recovers quickly and hope to welcome you back again at OHH MASSAGE.

I went for a foot massage and asked the therapist to avoid my toes. (I had an issue with my toes in the past. It has already healed, but I’m worried about irritating it or causing another injury). However, the therapist seemed reluctant and told me, “She’ll try.” …. Honestly, after hearing that, I almost didn’t want to continue the massage at all. But I had already paid for it.

Besides, I then asked if she could focus on a particular area that I feel sore. She told me that the shop has a pattern of massage that the therapists have to follow, and she cannot focus on the particular area for me.

The therapist asked me, “Have you been here before?” I don’t know why she ask me like that?
Yes, I have. I used to have a membership here and come regularly before COVID, several years ago. I haven’t been coming here as often after I moved to another area.

I’ve had massages at many other places over the years, and whenever I’ve mentioned that I needed a particular want or area, I’ve never had any therapist make it seem like such a difficult request.

To be fair, the massage itself is actually quite good. During massage time, the pressure can be adjusted based on my feedback, and I’m satisfied with it. However, I ended up spending the entire massage feeling anxious and worried about my toes. After this experience, I don’t think I’ll be coming back.

reviews.text:
This was my third massage in Bangkok, and it was unfortunately the worst.
To start, the lady at the counter was incredibly unfriendly, and they require payment upfront. I opted for the back massage, but unlike other parlors where you are given a change of clothes or the massage is done shirtless, I was forced to keep my shirt on. Had I known this beforehand, I would have changed, as the shirt I was wearing made the experience quite unpleasant. Because of the layers, the massage didn’t feel personalized at all; it was just a series of "presses" rather than an actual „massage“.
Furthermore, despite there being curtains between the mattresses, my therapist didn’t bother pulling them shut. There was basically no privacy, resulting in several moments of awkward eye contact with the person next to me.
I ended up leaving more tense than when I arrived. The only upside was the complimentary refreshments at the end: bananas, two small cookies, tea, and water.

reviews.name: Max Sushanov
reviews.text:
This is outrageous and disgusting. Your massage therapist started harassing me and touching me at the end of the massage... I feel devastated. I went for a medical sports massage, not the cheapest (950 baht), specifically to work on sore muscles, but instead I received emotional trauma. I demand a solution and compensation for emotional damages. I ask for an official response and compensation, otherwise I will be forced to report harassment to the Thai Tourist Police. I read about this salon in advance, and there was not a word about this, not in the reviews, not on the website, not on Google Maps. I am 19 years old, male, and was there on May 29, 2026, for an hour-long sports massage by appointment at 4:00 PM. The massage therapist was Weerawat (Mr. Liew).

19 September

Please note that this employee has not been fired and continues to work there.

In their response to my review, the company called me a liar and a fraudster.
All I managed to do was get a refund for the massage—nothing more.

After that, I messaged the company representative again—and honestly, it’s just absurd: they wrote that we could change the review as a "gesture of good faith"...
I’m speechless. Speaking of absurdity, the person actually told me I shouldn't have written a review about this in the first place.
Furthermore, in their response to my review, they cited and used information from a private WhatsApp conversation—even though they were the one who had personally asked for that conversation to remain confidential.
My reviews on Fresha and other platforms were either deleted or never published.
Please be careful and vigilant.
I have screenshots and other evidence to back up my statements and prove the facts of the situation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued guest,

We are deeply shocked and troubled by your review, and we want you to know that we take your account with the utmost seriousness.

We have zero tolerance for any behavior of this nature, and allegations of this gravity demand an immediate and thorough investigation. We have already noted the date, time, and therapist mentioned in your review, and our management team will be looking into this without delay.

We sincerely apologize that you are experiencing such distress, and we want to assure you that your wellbeing is our absolute priority. We kindly ask that you allow us a short time to conduct a proper internal review so that we may respond to you fully and responsibly. The therapist has been removed from service while the investigation takes place.

We remain committed to providing a safe, professional, and respectful environment for all clients and will cooperate fully with any relevant authorities should they become involved.

Please contact us directly at contact@bangkoksportsmassage.com so that we can speak with you privately and confidentially. We are committed to addressing this matter with the seriousness it deserves.

Sincerely,
Management – Bangkok Sports Massage

Update 16 September 2026

Thank you for taking the time to read this response.

We take all feedback seriously and have conducted a thorough investigation into this review. We continue to provide our full cooperation in any ongoing case.

We remain committed to providing excellent service to all our customers and appreciate your understanding and welcome any questions you may have about our business practices.

reviews.name: M A
reviews.text:
All of their massage treatments are very reasonably priced at just 200 THB per 60 minutes.

I found this place through reviews because it was close to my hotel. Since I was short on time, I asked for a 60-minute Thai massage instead of the original two-hour treatment.

I’ve always associated Thai massage with intense stretching and strong pressure, which I’m not usually a fan of. However, this treatment was quite different and exceeded my expectations!

The therapist used balm and oil to work on my back and legs, then wiped them off with a towel while continuing to massage. The session ended with some stretching, leaving me feeling incredibly refreshed.

Throughout the treatment, the therapist made excellent use of both hands and the entire arms, working efficiently to identify my particularly tight areas and focus on releasing the tension. I felt noticeably better and much more relaxed afterward.

If I’d had more time, I would have loved to try the full two-hour treatment as originally planned.

I would definitely come back if I’m in the area again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a proper, effective massage at an excellent price!

reviews.text:
การได้มาเรียนนวดหน้า 30 ชั่วโมงครั้งนี้ เป็นประสบการณ์ที่คุ้มค่ามากกว่าที่คิดไว้
ตอนแรกคิดว่าจะได้แค่เรียนท่านวด แต่พอได้ลงมือจริงกลับได้เรียนรู้ตั้งแต่โครงสร้างกล้ามเนื้อบนใบหน้า การลงน้ำหนักมือที่ถูกต้อง การเคลื่อนไหวแต่ละจังหวะ รวมถึงวิธีดูแลลูกค้าให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายและปลอดภัยตลอดการทำทรีตเมนต์
สิ่งที่ชอบที่สุดคือการได้ฝึกปฏิบัติจริงหลายรอบ ทำให้เข้าใจว่าการนวดหน้าที่ดีไม่ใช่แค่ "นวดเป็น" แต่ต้องใส่ใจในรายละเอียด ความนุ่มนวล และความสม่ำเสมอของทุกขั้นตอน
30 ชั่วโมงอาจดูไม่นาน แต่เป็นช่วงเวลาที่ได้ทั้งความรู้ ทักษะ และความมั่นใจมากขึ้น เห็นพัฒนาการของตัวเองในทุกวัน และทำให้ยิ่งรู้สึกว่าเส้นทางด้านความงามและการดูแลผิวเป็นสิ่งที่อยากพัฒนาต่ออย่างจริงจัง
ขอบคุณอาจารย์ที่ถ่ายทอดความรู้และเทคนิคอย่างละเอียด รวมถึงเพื่อนร่วมคลาสที่ช่วยกันฝึกและแลกเปลี่ยนประสบการณ์ บรรยากาศการเรียนเป็นกันเอง สนุก และได้กำลังใจกลับมาเต็ม ๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
This 30-hour facial massage course was more valuable than I ever imagined.
At first, I thought I would only learn massage techniques, but once I got hands-on experience, I learned everything from the facial muscle structure, the correct pressure, the movements of each stroke, and how to keep clients feeling relaxed and safe throughout the treatment.
What I liked most was the opportunity to practice multiple times. It made me understand that good facial massage isn't just about "knowing how to massage," but also about paying attention to detail, gentleness, and consistency in every step.
30 hours may not seem long, but it was a period that provided me with knowledge, skills, and increased confidence. Seeing my own progress every day made me realize even more that the path to beauty and skincare is something I want to seriously pursue further.
Thank you to the instructor for sharing knowledge and techniques in detail, as well as to my classmates who helped each other practice and exchange experiences. The learning atmosphere was friendly, fun, and I left feeling completely encouraged.

reviews.name: Patty
reviews.text:
慕名而來，用臉書訊息預訂了時間，但訂金需要用微信或支付寶付款，我無法付便提前過來現場支付。
這家可以預約時間是固定的，我預約16:30，同樣的時間會有一堆人一起進來。價格非常優惠，完全物超所值。

我選了120分鐘包括身體磨砂及精油按摩，磨砂膏跟精油都可以選擇、味道都很棒。
我的師傅是Poo女士，剛開始會幫忙洗腳，用檸檬搓腳底，相當享受。後面的磨砂過程非常仔細，施作完去沖洗可以感覺皮膚都嫩了許多。接著精油按摩更是享受，每一個酸痛及緊繃的點都被撫慰了。
這家在施作磨砂跟精油時，磨砂膏跟精油都是溫熱的，非常舒服，師傅也很在意客人的感受，完全大推。
完成後沒碰到師傅無法當面交付小費，希望櫃檯有確實轉交。
再來普吉絕對要回訪的好店家😍
reviews.textTranslated:
I came here after hearing so much about it and booked a time via Facebook, but the deposit required payment via WeChat or Alipay, which I couldn't afford, so I came early to pay on-site.

This place has fixed booking times; I booked for 4:30 PM, and there were a lot of people coming in at the same time. The price was very reasonable, definitely worth the money.

I chose a 120-minute session including body scrub and oil massage. They had a choice of scrub and oils, and they all smelled great.

My masseuse was Ms. Poo. She started by washing my feet and rubbing the soles with lemon, which was very enjoyable. The scrub was very thorough, and after rinsing, my skin felt much softer. The oil massage was even more enjoyable; every sore and tight spot was soothed.

During the scrub and oil massage, the scrub and oil were warm, which was very comfortable. The masseuse was also very attentive to her clients' comfort. Highly recommended!

After the massage, I couldn't give a tip in person, so I hope the counter has a system for transferring tips.

I will definitely visit this place again when I'm in Phuket! 😍

reviews.text:
ich war vom 8.-10. august im apk resort hotel in phuket und es war die schlimmste unterkunft für mich in ganz thailand.

ich musste grosse fette karkalaken töten und herausfinden aus welchem loch diese hässlichen dinger kommen… es war ein loch in der mitte vom bad und habe dort zahnbürsten reingestopft damit nicht noch mehr rauskommen und ausserdem gab es sehr viele kleine ameisen die sich von diesen karkalaken ernährt haben es war der horror ich konnte nicht 2 tage lang duschen dorr so dreckig war es.

Einen jaccuzzi hatte ich auch aber musste 1h warten bis der arbeiter den deckel gebracht hat (er ist 3 mal in dieser stunde gekommen und immer mit dem falschen) also das war sehr nervig und immer mit seinen hässlichen dreckigen schlarpen in mein zimmer reingelaufen ohne sie auszuziehen und hat alles dreckig gemacht den boden.

Also bodenlose unterkunft und nichtmal entschädigen wollten sie mich am ende für diese grausame qual oder als good will…

Seht die bilder selber…. Geht auf keinen fall dahin auch für das geld lohnt es sich überhaupt nicht…
reviews.textTranslated:
I stayed at the APK Resort Hotel in Phuket from August 8th to 10th, and it was the worst accommodation I've ever stayed in in all of Thailand.

I had to kill large, fat cockroaches and figure out where those ugly things were coming from… It was a hole in the middle of the bathroom, and I stuffed toothbrushes in it to stop more from coming out. There were also tons of tiny ants feeding on the cockroaches. It was a nightmare! I couldn't even shower for two days because it was so filthy.

I also had a jacuzzi, but I had to wait an hour for the maintenance worker to bring the cover (he came three times in that hour, and always with the wrong one). That was incredibly annoying. And he kept walking into my room in his ugly, dirty slippers without taking them off, making everything dirty, including the floor.


I also had a jacuzzi, but I had to wait an hour for the maintenance worker to bring the cover (he came three times in that hour, and always with the wrong one). So, the accommodation was absolutely terrible, and they didn't even offer me any compensation or goodwill gesture for this awful ordeal…

See the pictures for yourselves… Don't go there under any circumstances; it's not worth the money at all…

reviews.name: Israel Skuri
reviews.text:
Leaving a course halfway through, especially after paying a non-refundable 7,900THB - is not something I take lightly.

As a professional massage therapist who spent a full month taking intensive courses across Chiang Mai, I enrolled in the 2-day Hand Reflexology course at ITM SpaMantra expecting high-level instruction. Instead, the quality, structure, and time management were so poor that walking away and cutting my losses was the only sensible choice.

​When a course is advertised as a 15-hour program running from 09:00 to 17:30 over two days with a one-hour lunch break, I expect to receive 15 actual hours of education and practice.
What I experienced was artificially stretched to justify a two-day duration that could have easily been covered in a single day course.
​Throughout both days, practical hands-on application was severely lacking.
On day one, after the instructor demonstrated techniques on both of my hands, I was able to practice only once before being dismissed for lunch a half an hour early, at 11:30 AM. Class then ended completely at 15:30 PM instead of 17:30 PM.
On the second day, we finished the entire course booklet within just one hour, and out of the two hours I was in class, I practiced for merely 15 minutes on a single hand.

To make matters worse, Throughout both days, every 20 to 30 minutes the instructor would leave for an unscheduled "bathroom break" disappearing for 10 to 15 minutes each time without explanation, leaving me sitting alone in the room.

​The breaking point came at 11:15 AM on day two when the instructor dismissed me again for a nearly two-hour lunch break until 13:00 PM. When I asked if I should return at 12:15 PM to keep practicing, he simply replied that class starts at 13:00 PM, but I could "come back early and take a nap in the classroom." That was the moment I realized no further educational value or professional guidance would be gained. While the instructor gave me a pleasant massage, and offerd Thai herbal tea, I did not pay 7,900 THB for a spa session, I paid to learn!

​I spoke with the polite manager, requested my certificate, and left.
While the staff were very friendly and the facilities were clean, politeness does not replace proper education. As an institution with an international reputation charging premium fees, this level of training is completely unacceptable. If you are a serious, practicing therapist looking for active guidance, anatomy-focused learning, and real respect for your time, I cannot recommend this course.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Israel,
Thank you for your honest feedback and for taking the time to share your experience with us. We truly appreciate hearing from our students, as their feedback helps us continue to improve.

We are genuinely sorry to learn that the course did not meet your expectations. Providing a positive and professional learning experience for students from around the world has always been our priority, and we regret that your experience did not reflect the standard we strive to achieve.

We recognize that every student brings different expectations, learning preferences, and professional experience to the classroom. We fully respect your perspective and sincerely appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us.

Your comments regarding the class structure, scheduling, and overall learning experience have been shared with our management team and instructor for careful review. We will continue to learn from feedback like yours as we strive to make our programs and learning experience even better.

Thank you again for your feedback. We sincerely wish you continued success in your professional career and appreciate the opportunity to learn from your experience.
🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Ann Karimi
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, this was one of the worst massage and nail experiences I’ve ever had. I decided to book this place as the owner gave us a good deal  but the next day when we went it was just the staff who were around. During the 1 hour Thai massage session the staff were chatting non stop and laughing which made the experience very uncomfortable and completely unprofessional. A massage is supposed to be relaxing, but this was anything but that.

The manicure and pedicure were also poorly done, and hygiene was lacking as I never saw any equipment being disinfected. The polish was applied unevenly, and some nails had to be redone and the overall results were just terrible as she didn’t even let the nails dry . However, by that point, I was fed up and simply wanted to leave because I had had enough. It honestly seemed as though the staff did not know what they were doing.

The lady who did my manicure and pedicure was particularly annoying, as she spent most of the session gossiping and laughing. Luckily, I understand some Thai, and I could make up that she gossiping about me to her colleagues, which was extremely disrespectful. It was just the poorest quality of the basic service I have ever received.

Another major issue was how incredibly slow everything was. The massage and manicure/pedicure took around four hours altogether. It felt as though the staff were deliberately taking their time, perhaps to make the shop appear busy and attract people walking past.

It’s such a shame because the owner, whom we had previously met, seemed reasonable and fair. Unfortunately, staff members like these can seriously damage a business’s reputation. Good customer service and professionalism are just as important as the services themselves, and sadly, neither was present during our visit.

I definitely would not recommend this place based on my experience.

reviews.name: EBB Teo
reviews.text:
As tourists, we love exploring Bangkok and often pop into massage centres wherever it’s convenient. The quality can vary quite a bit, so finding a really good one is always a bonus.

RuamRudee was recommended to us by our hotel concierge, and boy, what a recommendation! They have some truly wonderful Thai massage therapists here.

We had a two-hour Thai massage, and it was pure bliss. I even “discovered” muscles I never knew existed!

To my friends and me, this is the best massage centre in Bangkok. What sets this place apart is the exceptional skill of its therapists.

If you read this review and decide to give them a try, and you’re as impressed by their skills as we were, I’d encourage you to leave your therapist a little extra tip. They truly deserve the appreciation for the wonderful work they do.

reviews.textTranslated:
I happened to run into the same person who commented earlier about a masseur being lazy, pressing on my tailbone, and having ineffective communication...

90 minutes of full-body oil massage for 700 yuan. The fan was on its strongest setting, blowing directly at my head. After I spoke to her, she just laughed and said, "You're cold, I'm hot..." and then turned it down while continuing to blow... Finally, I felt really uncomfortable and asked if she could turn it off, but she just pulled the curtain closed. It was cold the whole time.

Also, she used stroking from beginning to end, not pressing any acupoints. She rubbed my back and feet for a long time, but didn't press my hands or the soles of my feet. She didn't even massage my shoulders and neck for a minute. It ended with the lights on.

reviews.name: Whistle Blower
reviews.text:
I had every intention of trying this spa after walking past it earlier in the day. It looked inviting, so I decided to come back that evening.

Before going in, I was finishing a cigarette well away from the entrance. The group the owner was upset with wasn't directly in front of the spa either. They were further down the road outside a nearby bar. That's what made the whole situation seem so strange to me.

The foreign owner suddenly came outside and began loudly confronting the group while what appeared to be recording them with a body-worn camera or similar device. Unfortunately, he also seemed to assume I was with them and directed comments toward me, even though I wasn't part of the group.

What really put me off wasn't that he objected to people smoking. It was the way he handled it. From my perspective, it came across like someone having a temper tantrum rather than handling the situation calmly or professionally. If he genuinely believed there was a problem, there are more appropriate ways to deal with it than yelling at people who weren't even standing in front of his business.

The entire interaction felt awkward, confrontational, and honestly a bit unsettling. It's not the kind of first impression you'd expect from a place that's supposed to promote relaxation and wellness.

Because of that experience, I decided not to go inside. I can't comment on the quality of the massages or the spa itself because I never became a customer. My decision was based entirely on that interaction, which unfortunately was enough for me to take my business elsewhere.

개인적으로는 전체적인 압 조절이 아쉬웠던 첫 방문이었습니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
I am leaving an honest review after my first visit. Since it was fully booked, I managed to secure a one-hour slot with difficulty and received a one-hour Thai massage.

However, I was a bit disappointed because the pressure applied by the masseuse was generally too weak. The massage using the hands and elbows felt so light that I wasn't even sure if I was receiving a massage.

On the other hand, the massage using the feet to press on my thighs was actually too painful, and even though I told them to press harder several times, the pressure was not significantly adjusted.

Personally, it was a first visit where the overall pressure control was disappointing.

reviews.text:
I accidentally posted a new review over the one below (April). So, I'm reposting it. The new review will be posted separately.

--
This is going to be a very long review because I want to do the masseuses and the management justice. I also want to give you more information that you are seeking, based on my own positive experience.

Let's start with *My Masseuse*: Since my last visit, I have gone back to see my masseuse, Jane (Honey Bee), twice more. She did not disappoint. Each time, she would try her best to make me feel good and relaxed. She was conscientious and professional like that. Aways personable, always cheerful, with a cute sense of playfulness - that's her personality, which is an added bonus to her good looks.

*The Girls*: During these visits, I had the opportunity to speak to several masseuses, notably Jeab, Maxie, A, Mint, Neko (Kiss Bangkok) and Janet (Honey Bee). All of them were charismatic, friendly, spunky and fun to be around. People you would love to hang out with outside as well. They left a good impression on me.

I saw Wanni from Bangkok Bunny (she's better-looking in person). Others I came across were Amy, Maple, Note, Lisa, Elle, Irina. There were yet more attractive faces that I didn't manage to put a name to, given my time there. You can refer to the photos on the Kiss Bangkok website for most of them, but note that not all the girls have their photos posted online. You'll have to find out for yourself in person.

*The Business*: For those unacquainted with the four establishments -- namely Kiss Bangkok, Bangkok Passion, Bangkok Bunny and Honey Bee -- they are under the same boss, but managed by different supervisors. Regardless, when you walk into the alley, you'll be spoiled for choice as you can ask for anyone at any of these 4 parlours. There's no "Wrong Door" policy here.

*The Logistics*: The individual rooms were clean, air-conditioned, and furnished with amenities suited for different services.

*Plus point*: Unlike some harassment I saw online, the ladies here were welcoming, definitely not pushy. If the potential customers were not interested, these ladies were classy enough to shrug it off and smile good-naturedly as part of the job.

Jane, Jeab, Maxie were conversant in English, while the others such as A, Janet, Neko, and Mint could speak English in varying degrees. This was definitely helpful in creating a rapport between customer/client and masseuse.

*My Personal Experience*: Through these encounters, I noted and respected that everyone was a professional who took pride in her work; simply genuine women trying to make a living.

*Verdict*: In a nutshell, I would choose this place again if and when I return.
5 stars for the ladies who work at these establishments and the Management that operates them well.

Last but not least, 5 stars for my masseuse, Jane, of course. Much as I would like to selfishly "hoard" her for myself, this wouldn't be a fair review if I did.

There you have it. Go check it out yourself, explore, experience, enjoy, stay respectful and stay safe!

reviews.name: xue ruo (天)
reviews.text:
この2日間、Classyに2回行きましたが、本当に大満足でした。今回のバンコク旅行をとても楽しい形で締めくくることができました。

お店は路地を少し奥まで入ったところにありますが、そこまで分かりにくくはありません。むしろ、可愛い女の子がたくさんいるお店を見つけたら、たぶんそこです（笑）

女の子たちはお店共通の制服を着ていて、スタイルがとても綺麗に見えるデザインです。ストッキングとの組み合わせも雰囲気があって、とても良かったです。

今回は BuddyさんとAriさん に会いましたが、2人とも本当に素敵でした。

Buddyさんはとても積極的で、雰囲気作りやコミュニケーションが上手。Ariさんはとても可愛らしくて、甘い雰囲気の女の子です。
タイプは全然違いますが、どちらも本当に魅力的で、バンコク旅行の最後をとても楽しい思い出にしてくれました。

そして、お店のママさんにも本当に感謝しています。 とても責任感があり、予約の段階から何度も助けていただきました。私の好みや希望、気持ちにも細かく気を配ってくれて、時間や予約の調整も丁寧に対応してくれました。初めてのお客さんやお店に慣れていない人でも安心できるような対応で、今回このお店にとても良い印象を持った大きな理由の一つです。

唯一残念だったのは、今回の旅行で遊びすぎて自分の体力が残っておらず、2人一緒のコースを試す機会がなかったことです（笑）。次回バンコクに来た時、元気があればぜひ挑戦してみたいと思います。

あと、一つだけ希望があります。今後もし可能であれば、一般的なクレジットカード決済にも対応してもらえると、さらに便利だと思います。
現在はAlipayとWeChat Payが使えるので中国人旅行者にはとても便利ですが、普段Visa / Mastercard / Apple Payなどに慣れている日本・韓国や他の国からの旅行者にとっては、カード決済があるとより使いやすいと思います。

総合的には本当に大満足です。BuddyさんもAriさんも素敵で、ママさんもとても親切で頼りになり、スタッフの対応も素晴らしかったです。次にバンコクへ来た時も、ぜひまた行きたいと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
I went to Classy twice over the past two days, and I was truly very satisfied. It was a wonderful way to end my Bangkok trip.

The shop is located a little way down an alley, but it's not that hard to find. In fact, if you see a shop with lots of cute girls, that's probably it (laughs).

The girls wear a uniform that's shared by the shop, and it's designed to make them look very stylish. The combination with the stockings was also very nice and created a great atmosphere.

I met Buddy and Ari this time, and they were both wonderful.

Buddy is very proactive and good at creating a good atmosphere and communicating. Ari is very cute and has a sweet aura.

They are completely different types, but both are really charming and made the end of my Bangkok trip a very enjoyable memory.

And I'm truly grateful to the shop's owner. She is very responsible and helped me many times from the reservation stage. She paid close attention to my preferences, wishes, and feelings, and handled the time and reservation adjustments very carefully. The staff's attentive service, which made even first-time customers and those unfamiliar with the establishment feel at ease, was a major reason why I had such a positive impression of this place.

The only regrettable thing was that I had too much fun on this trip and didn't have the energy to try the two-person course (laughs). Next time I come to Bangkok, if I have the energy, I'd definitely like to try it.

Also, I have one request. If possible, it would be even more convenient if you could accept general credit card payments.

Currently, Alipay and WeChat Pay are accepted, which is very convenient for Chinese tourists, but for travelers from Japan, Korea, and other countries who are used to Visa/Mastercard/Apple Pay, having card payment options would make it even easier to use.

Overall, I was truly very satisfied. Buddy and Ari were wonderful, the owner was very kind and reliable, and the staff's service was excellent. I would definitely like to visit again the next time I come to Bangkok.

強力推薦！來清邁四天，這間我按了四次(三次按腳、一次去樓上按肩頸)，飯店剛好在隔壁，又看到有人推薦就來按了，結果一試成主顧，價格也很實惠，至少遇到兩個不同按摩師力道都很合適，整天在外面逛，晚上按完回飯店太享受了~~

另外要說的是，一小時350的肩頸其實會按摩全身，只是肩頸部分有加強，腳的部分真的超舒服，我是按完最後一小時才依依不捨去機場的!!

唯一可能會有人在意的可能是環境沒有很新、很明亮吧！比較像在地小理髮廳的那種感覺，但也可能是裝潢簡單，被外觀吸引進來的客人不多，走進去就能直接按，都不用預約真的很讚！
reviews.textTranslated:
Highly recommended! I spent four days in Chiang Mai and had four massages here (three foot massages and one upstairs shoulder and neck massage). My hotel was right next door, and I saw someone recommend it, so I decided to try it. I became a regular customer after just one visit! The price is very reasonable, and both of the two different masseuses I had massaged had just the right amount of pressure. After a long day of sightseeing, a massage before heading back to the hotel was so relaxing!

Also worth mentioning is that the 350 baht per hour shoulder and neck massage actually includes a full-body massage, but with a focus on the shoulder and neck area. The foot massage was incredibly comfortable; I didn't leave until the last hour was over before heading to the airport!

The only thing some people might mind is that the environment isn't very new or bright. It's more like a small local hair salon. But that might mean fewer customers are drawn in by the simple decor. You can just walk in and get a massage without needing an appointment, which is really great!

reviews.name: Barbara Pugliatti
reviews.text:
You MUST come in and ask for their terapeutic massage if you have any cronic pain issue. This was the most helpful treatment I ever had in my entire life. I know it may seems like an exageration but it’s not. I’m just enthisiast because it really helped me a lot. I spent so much time and money in physical therapy, osteopaths, chiropractors, products, medications and medical exams with nothing but minor or very temporary improvements, everyone who has chronic pain can relate for sure. Imagine feeling a massive improvement on something that was troubling you for years. This is what happened to me.

Mind, this will not be a relaxing hour and it’s not the classic, stretchy thai massage either. You may curse me during it from time to time. But you will thank me later.

Here’s my experience:
First I went in for my foot. I have a very frail hankle situation and for me it was painful to walk more than 4k steps, even with proper shoes.
Also I had a problem in my front foot, no doctor identified precisely what it was, but for years I was unable to wear heels without feeling a massive amount of pain.

Well, this is now the past.

Now I have no pain anymore and I’m walking 10k steps a day minimum. I had no chance to try high heels yet, but I have no pain standing on my points and this is already such a massive improvement. She dedicated and entire hour working only on my foot and leg.

After some day I was able to tell this was no temporary relief. So I went again for my neck, which is in a really bad shape, worsened by office posture. It also gave me headhache every other day.

First, she was able to identify the stiffness I always feel in my middle back, even if I didn’t told her about it. then she proceeded manipulating my neck shoulder and arms. I can tell my neck would have benefited from more than one session and that the problem is not solved, but still it is so much better now! Headache are gone. After the massage I had to go back to the hotel because I felt exausted. I slept as a baby.

I only wish I could bring this lady back home with me. 🥹 thank you so much, I wish you all the best of this world and please share this knowledge as much as you can, it will help so many people out there!

You get beaten up with their elbows.

reviews.name: M Long
reviews.text:
Went for a massage with my partner on a rainy afternoon. We both had the 1hr oil Thai Massage. Massage for myself was quite harsh in places especially shoulders and lots of pressure, more so than other massages I have had previously. My partner said the massage was ‘alright’ but nothing special.
Massage definitely didn’t feel like 1hr but we had no way of tracking the time so unable to confirm if we had the full 1hr or not. Atmosphere at the end of the massage felt awkward when staff realised we were not going to be tipping extra and it felt that was expected, their attitude towards us became cold.

reviews.name: Jidapa Thanayukulsri
reviews.text: ใช้บริการโปร นวดไทย 2 ชม 500 สถานที่โอเคค่ะ มีที่จอดรถ ร้านตกแต่งสวยงาม พนักงานบริการดี มรการสอบถามก่อนว่อต้องการให้นวดแรงระดับไหน เราเลือกปานกลางค่ะ แต่พี่พนักงานนวดค่อนข้างแรง นวดรีดน่อง จนเท้าเป็นตะคริว แล้วก็ตอนนวดหลัง ไม่แน่ใจว่ารีดเส้นหรือยังไง แต่มันเจ็บมาก หรือเราต้องเลือกระดับนวดเบา (แต่ไปที่อื่นก็บอกปานกลางตลอดนะคะ) พอตื่นมาอีกวันเหมือนร่างกายระบมไปหมดเลย คือไม่เคยเป็น ไม่รู้ว่าคนอื่นเป็นมั้ย แต่ไปนวดที่อื่นไม่เคยเจ็บขนาดนี้ค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I used their Thai massage service, 2 hours for 500 baht. The place is okay, there's parking, the shop is beautifully decorated, and the staff are friendly. They asked beforehand what level of pressure I preferred; I chose medium. However, the masseuse was quite strong, massaging my calves so hard that my feet cramped. Also, during the back massage, I'm not sure if it was deep tissue massage or what, but it was very painful. Maybe I should have chosen a lighter pressure? (But other places I've been to always say medium pressure.) When I woke up the next day, my body felt sore all over. I've never experienced this before. I don't know if others have, but I've never had a massage this painful elsewhere.

reviews.name: Ange75
reviews.text:
Des dizaines de masseurs et masseuses que j’ai expérimentés depuis plus de 20 ans, ce lieu vaut 5 étoiles, loin du clinquant de certaines jolies vitrines où  la qualité ne suit pas. Approchez-vous et essayez! Les masseurs, tous malvoyants, sont d’une grande délicatesse... et efficacité pour vos tensions ou douleurs.  Ils savent adapter la force du massage ( light, medium ou strong) à la demande. J’ai eu entre autres recours à Graeh (prononcez Gray),  l'une des rares masseuses, qui a eu ma préférence. Mais tous sont bons! Le lieu est très propre (y compris pour une maniaque de la propreté !), le massage sur mesure, et, après le massage, le thé servi léger est unique, avec la coupelle de fruits frais succulents. La gérante à l’accueil parle anglais. Certains masseurs parlent également quelques mots d’anglais et de chinois. Mieux que le thai conservation massage club a Chiang Mai old city, il n’y a pas!
Having experienced dozens of massage therapists over the past 20 years, I can say this place deserves 5 stars, a far cry from the flashy facades of some pretty establishments where quality is lacking. Go and try it! The massage therapists, all visually impaired, are incredibly gentle and effective at addressing your tension and pain. They know how to adjust the intensity of the massage (light, medium, or strong) to your needs. I particularly enjoyed Graeh (pronounced Gray), one of the few female therapists, who was my favorite. But they're all excellent! The place is spotless (even for a cleanliness fanatic!), the massage is personalized, and the light tea at the end is unique, served with a bowl of delicious fresh fruits. The manager at reception understands English. Some of the massage therapists also speak a few words of English and Chinese. You won't find better than the Thai Conservation Massage Club in Chiang Mai's Old City!

The therapist chuckled at how stiff my back was, but adjusted the pressure to a pleasantly painful level as she massaged it.
However, she pressed quite hard from the start, so those with a low pain tolerance should be careful (lol).
I was very satisfied, so next time I think I'll request a 90-minute or 120-minute session.

reviews.name: Z Ren
reviews.text: I have my best massage with Cherry here. She can tell which muscle is tight and she focus on them. I felt great after. I went here three times because she is so good. I felt my body is more flexible after the massage.

reviews.name: Jens B
reviews.text:
We had a foot massage here, which was okay overall. Unfortunately, it was impossible to relax. Several guests from an MMA gym were having loud conversations throughout the massage, and despite the obvious disturbance, none of the massage therapists asked them to lower their voices.

A massage should be a quiet and relaxing experience, so this significantly affected our visit. The massage itself was fine, but the atmosphere was anything but relaxing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We apologize for what happened, but we tried to inform the customer. So sorry again

reviews.name: Rohan Lee
reviews.text:
The owner here is lovely, and the staff are great.

They also rent motorbikes. After being ripped off by a bike rental place down the street, who tried every dirty trick in the book to steal my money,  I ended up giving the bike back and coming here to Radamanee to hiring a bike, the bikes were good quality and most of all the owner and staff were very honest and helpful.

Highly reccomend renting a bike from here.

reviews.name: LS
reviews.text:
Давно хотела оставить отзыв об этом месте. Если были рядом, всегда выбирали этот массажный салон. Делали разные массажи, мне каждый раз везло с мастером, все нравилось)
Однозначно советую, особенно массаж ног)
Потрясающий персонал, очень милая женщина администратор. Всегда находили окошки для нашей компании.
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been meaning to leave a review about this place for a while. Whenever we were nearby, we always chose this massage parlor. We've had different massages, and I've always been lucky with the therapist, and I loved everything.
I definitely recommend it, especially the foot massage.
Amazing staff, very nice receptionist. They always found a slot for our group.

reviews.name: K LEN ORGAN
reviews.text: Almost all the masseuses at the shop are able to give massages according to the client's needs, and I rarely have to tell them where I'm in pain.Most massage therapists in the salon can perform pressure point massages; you can tell them where you have particular pain or where you don't want the massage to be too strong.The service was very friendly and everyone was lovely.

The service from all the staff is excellent, the massage rooms are beautiful and private, and the overall atmosphere is superb compared to other massage places I've been to. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Yu-Chun Yeh
reviews.text:
🇹🇼🇹🇼🇹🇼
在清邁按摩四次，這間最棒，推薦BO師傅油壓$599/h，技巧非常好，都有按到重點，非常推薦！也感謝他們照顧與招待兩個幼兒
reviews.textTranslated: 🇹🇼🇹🇼🇹🇼 This was the best massage I had in Chiang Mai, one of four sessions. I highly recommend Master Bo's oil massage ($599/hour). His technique is excellent; he always hits the key points. Highly recommended! Also, thank you for taking care of my two young children.

reviews.textTranslated: The shop is on the second floor, and there are many restaurants on the first floor. It's about a 10-minute walk from Central Plaza, but the environment is definitely better than the massage parlor inside Central Plaza. My feet were sore from walking around, but I got a full recovery here.

reviews.name: Yo Yo
reviews.text: 给我按摩是一位男士，手势非常舒适，不失力道，一次不错的体验。
reviews.textTranslated: The massage I received was from a man whose techniques were very comfortable yet firm; it was a great experience.

reviews.name: rita lin
reviews.text: 清邁旅遊，隨意找飯店附近的按摩店，意外的讓人很滿意，我跟先生都很滿意他們的按摩及服務，值得推薦！
reviews.textTranslated: While traveling in Chiang Mai, we randomly picked a massage parlor near our hotel and were pleasantly surprised by how satisfying it was. My husband and I were both very happy with the massage and service, and we highly recommend it!

A local Thai massage shop offering traditional Thai massage, oil massage, foot massage, and neck & shoulder massage at affordable prices.

Clean, quiet, and relaxing environment with experienced hands. Strong pressure available upon request.

Great for back pain, stiff shoulders, sore legs, and muscle recovery. Popular with athletes and active people. Foreigners welcome.

reviews.name: Lucius Aurelius
reviews.text:
In this area I think the best massage! First time I've been there and already love it. I recommend Dew, she has very good hands and absolutely will cure any muscle pain you may have it. Not too strong, not too light, just perfect! Also the staff is very kind and smiley. Sure I will come back because working on a computer and sitted everyday, I really enjoyed the massage on my inner thighs, buttocks, and abdomen. She did a great job and make me feel like new! Prices are reasonable. The shop is small but clean. I went early in the morning and I got my massage instantly. It's easy to find on Google maps. There is a shower for the oil massage. In the end the ginger tea was delicious!

Thank you so much for the very good experience Dew.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very happy that our customers are satisfied with the service provided by our staff and we would like to express our sincere gratitude for the review. 🙏

reviews.name: Bow BKC
reviews.text:
เคยไปครั้งนึง นวดโอเคอยู่ค่ะ แต่แอบเฟลคือตอนเรานวดใกล้เสร็จ มีต่างชาติเดินเข้ามา 2 คน นวดคู่ แล้วเตียงมีอยู่แค่ 2 เตียง เจ้าของร้านเลยหันมาเร่งคนนวดว่า จะเสร็จหรือยัง คนนวดเลยต้องรีบปล่อยเตียง จริงๆอีก 10 นาทีถึงจะครบชั่วโมงเรา เลยลังเลว่าจะไปซ้ำดีไหม จริงๆอยู่คอนโดแถวนี้ หาร้านนวดประจำอยู่ แอบรู้สึกว่าร้าน concern ประโยชน์ตัวเองจนเอาเปรียบลูกค้าไปหน่อย เสียใจ ต้นซอยร้านก็ต้องเดินระวังรถหน่อย

(ตอนเดินเข้าไปเหมือนเจ้าของร้านเถียงกับลูกน้องหมอนวดอะไรกันอยู่ก็แทบจะไม่สนใจเราลูกค้าที่เดินเข้าไป)
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been there once. The massage was okay, but I was a bit disappointed because near the end of my massage, two foreigners walked in for a couples massage, and there were only two massage beds. The owner turned to the masseuse and urged her to finish quickly, so the masseuse had to let go of the bed. Actually, I still had 10 minutes left until my hour was up. I'm hesitant about going back. I actually live in a condo nearby and am looking for a regular massage place. I feel like the shop is too concerned with its own benefit and taking advantage of customers. It's a shame. You have to be careful walking near the shop as it's at the beginning of the street because of the traffic.

(When I walked in, it seemed like the owner was arguing with her employee/massage therapist and barely paid any attention to me, a customer.)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ต้องกราบขอโทษขออภัยลูกค้าด้วยค่ะที่ทำให้ลูกค้ารู้สึกไม่ดีต่อการบริการของทางร้านคือทางร้านอาจมีการผิดพลาดตรงดูนาฬิกาผิดพลาดไปเพราะปกติเจ้าของร้านจะมีกฏห้ามพนักงานลงก่อนเวลาเป็นอันขาดต้องขอโทษลูกค้าจริงๆๆทึ่มีการผิดพลาดค่ะ🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.text: ในที่สุดก็หาเจอร้านนวดที่จริงใจ❤️ พี่บีนวดดีมาก กดโดนทุกจุด ❤️ ฉันทำอาชีพที่นั่งท่าเดียวทำงานทั้งวัน มีปัญหาปวดเอว คอ บ่า ไหล่ และปวดไมเกรนเนื่องจากใช้สายตาที่เพ่งเล็งตลอดเวลา ปวดเมื่อยจนนอนไม่ได้ เปลี่ยนร้านนวด เปลี่ยนหมอนวดมาหลายร้านแต่ไม่เคยมีหมอนวดคนไหนนวดได้ดีเท่าที่นี่มาก่อน ตอนนี้สบายตัวมากๆๆ จะกลับไปใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน ใครที่มองหาร้านนวดดีๆแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ 🥰❤️
reviews.textTranslated: Finally found a truly sincere massage shop ❤️ The masseuse, Bee, is amazing! The pain was so bad I couldn't sleep. I've tried many massage shops and masseuses, but none have ever been as good as this one. I feel so much better now! I will definitely be back. If you're looking for a great massage shop, I highly recommend this place! 🥰❤️

reviews.name: Rejuvi_Ms. Heo
reviews.text: 한국인들에게도 너무나도 유명한 방콕 메리어트 마르퀴즈 퀸스 파크 호텔 스파입니다. 콴 스파는 메리어트의 전용 스파로 유명한데 다른 지역 호텔의 콴 스파는 가격대가 높아서 진입이 어려웠지만 고와비 앱에 방콕 콴 스파딜이 있어 아큐펑쳐 마사지를 합리적인 가격으로 바우처 구입하였습니다. 메리어트답게 고급스럽고 응대가 좋았으며 낮에 갔지만 빛 차단이 잘되어 청결한 컨디션에서 마사지 받으며 푹 쉬었습니다. 지금까지 타이 마사지 받을 때 입은 타이 마사지복 중에 촉감이 가장 좋았습니다.
reviews.textTranslated: This is the Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen's Park Hotel Spa, which is incredibly famous among Koreans. Quan Spa is renowned as Marriott's exclusive spa; while Quan Spas at other hotels are typically expensive and difficult to access, I was able to purchase a voucher for an Acupuncture massage at a reasonable price thanks to a deal on the Gowabi app. True to Marriott's reputation, the atmosphere was luxurious and the service was excellent. Although I visited during the day, the lighting was well-blocked, allowing me to relax fully while receiving a massage in a clean environment. The Thai massage attire I wore this time felt the best of all the Thai massage outfits I have ever worn.

reviews.name: 블루
reviews.text:
개 강 추
진짜 시원하고 개운하고 다 좋아요 한국에서도 자주받아서 기준치가 높은데 여긴 엄청 만족스러웠어요
하나의 단점만 뽑자면 샤워실에 곰팡이가 있다는것 하지만 연속으로 갈만큼 너무나 만족스런 마사지
reviews.textTranslated:
Highly recommended

It’s really refreshing, invigorating, and just great. I get massages frequently in Korea, so my standards are high, but I was extremely satisfied here.

If I had to pick just one downside, it would be that there was mold in the shower room, but the massage was so satisfying that I would go back again and again.

reviews.name: KU BEOM KIM
reviews.text: 고와비 할인으로 다녀온 콴스파인데 방콕 호텔스파는 퀄리티가 진짜 좋은데 가격도 합리적이라 너무 좋습니다. 테라피스트 실력도 너무 좋고 서비스도 훌륭해요. 압 조절도 잘 되고 테라피스트와 소통도 쉽습니다. 끝나고 나서 쿠키와 차 주는데 쿠키도 깔끔하게 랩핑 다 되어있는게 아주 인상적입니다. 좋은 경험이었어요
reviews.textTranslated: I visited Quan Spa using a Gowabi discount, and I really love that Bangkok hotel spas offer such high quality at a reasonable price. The therapists are very skilled, and the service is excellent. The pressure is well-adjusted, and communication with the therapist is easy. reviews.textTranslated:
The environment was nice! There were private rooms and bathrooms, but the services were mostly 2 hours long. I chose a 2-hour oil massage, but was assigned to a novice masseur. From the foot massage, I could tell he was a beginner, and yet I was stuck with a 2-hour massage. After less than 5 minutes, I asked to switch to a more skilled masseur. Around 8:30 PM, the masseur said there were no more masseurs available and I couldn't cancel because the service was closed!

I said I could come back the next day and asked for a more skilled masseur. Later, the counter staff came in and asked why I wanted to change masseurs. Because I hadn't made a reservation in advance, I couldn't choose a masseur; this was purely my personal opinion.

So, I have to accept being served by this novice masseur for 2 hours. 2 hours of oil massage costs 1380 baht, and then regardless of skill level, I'm expected to tip 100 baht per hour? That doesn't make sense!

I said if they wouldn't let me cancel and get a refund, I would have to write a review. The counter staff said the masseur wasn't a complete novice and could refund half the fee. Wait a minute... wasn't the service closed? How can they refund half the fee? Was the previous request unreasonable?

I asked again, how do I make an appointment in advance?

They refunded half the fee at the counter, hoping I could give an honest review, not just my personal feelings about the inexperienced mechanic. That's all.

reviews.name: M M (Mm)
reviews.text:
I had a strange experience here.

I had two massages at this place. The first one was good, so I came back a second time and chose an oil massage.

I was asked whether I preferred a male or female therapist. I said either was fine, and my therapist was a man.

The massage itself felt very good, but at one point he pointed to the front of my body and asked, “Do you want me to massage here too?” I said yes because I assumed he meant my stomach or collarbone area. However, he then started massaging my breasts.

I felt uncomfortable, but since it was my first oil massage, I wondered if this was somehow normal in Thailand, so I let it pass.
Later, he asked me, “Do you want a special massage?” I asked what that meant, and he replied, “B2B.” I didn’t know what that was, so I declined. I looked it up afterward and found out that it referred to a sexual massage.

I was surprised that something like this could happen even at a regular massage shop, and I later realized that massaging my breasts was not a normal part of the treatment either.

For women visiting this place, I would recommend requesting a female therapist if you have any concerns.

This is a very dynamic and powerful technique called "Double Foot Press" in Chiang Mai-style Thai massage.

The therapist sits with their legs extended and uses both feet to press the back of the thighs in a "sideways walking" motion, delivering a more stable, deeper, and stronger pressure than when using only one foot.

Key Points of the Treatment
"Sideways Walking" Rhythm: Just like striking a keyboard, shift your weight alternately between your right and left feet, moving from "above the back of the knee → middle → in front of the ischium." This rhythm is key to releasing the client's tension.

Therapist's Weight Shift: In the seated position, instead of pushing with arm strength, the trick is to slightly lean your upper body forward, as if "bringing your navel closer to the client," and shift your weight onto both feet.

The Role of the Hands (Anchor for Stability):
Hands holding the ankle: These act as support to prevent the bent leg from falling outwards.

Hands holding the knee: By fixing the straight leg to the floor, the pressure from both feet is not released and reaches deep into the hamstrings.
Expected effects:
Maximum surface pressure: Because both feet are used, the client feels a comfortable pressure as if being "pushed by a big wave."
Thorough muscle fiber massage: The alternating foot movements move the hamstring muscle fibers in multiple directions, powerfully increasing flexibility.

This is a highly technical and dynamic technique using traditional foot pressure from Chiang Mai-style Thai massage. In particular, it incorporates a technique to deliver stable and strong pressure to the client's hamstrings by creating a "leg lock."

This document summarizes the key points of this technique and precautions for safe and effective execution.

1. Positioning and Locking
The process of crossing the client's legs over the therapist's legs to "lock" them is crucial for the therapist's own body stability and protection of the client's hip and knee joints.

Securing a fulcrum: By placing the client's foot under the therapist's knee and holding the heel, a "lever fulcrum" is created to prevent the client's leg from slipping.

Supporting the back of the knee: By grasping the back of the knee with the other hand, hyperextension (over-bending) of the knee joint is prevented, allowing for safe and concentrated pressure on the hamstrings.

2. Pressure Application and Rhythm
The "12321" rhythm is fundamental to the approach to "Sen" (energy lines) in Thai massage.
Differentiation of Foot Sole and Side (Temporal) Use:
Entire Sole: Apply gentle, sustained pressure using a broad surface area.
Temporal (Outer Side of Foot): Target deeper layers and the edges of specific muscles.

เพื่อนของเราได้แจ้งขอน้ำหนักเพิ่ม เพราะเป็นคนที่ใช้กล้ามเนื้อเยอะ แต่พนักงานตอบในลักษณะว่าทำได้เท่านี้ เนื่องจากตัวเองก็ใช้แรงในการทำงานเหมือนกัน ซึ่งทำให้รู้สึกแปลกใจและไม่ค่อยเป็นมืออาชีพ

สำหรับตัวเราเอง ระหว่างนวดพนักงานลุกออกไปโดยไม่มีการแจ้งล่วงหน้า และหายไปช่วงหนึ่งก่อนกลับมาให้บริการต่อ เหตุการณ์แบบนี้ทำให้ประสบการณ์ขาดความต่อเนื่อง และรู้สึกว่ารายละเอียดเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ ยังไม่ได้รับการใส่ใจเท่าที่ควร

โดยรวมแล้ว เป็นประสบการณ์ที่ค่อนข้างเฟล เมื่อเทียบกับสิ่งที่คาดหวัง ทั้งในด้านบรรยากาศและการบริการ คิดว่ายังมีหลายจุดที่ควรปรับปรุงค่ะ

I was quite disappointed with this experience, as I expected more.

From the moment we arrived, the welcome didn’t feel particularly warm. The shop also only accepts cash and credit cards, which may not be convenient for some customers.

During the massage, the environment was not very relaxing as the room felt noticeably warm.
My friend requested stronger pressure due to frequent muscle use, but the therapist responded that they could only apply that level of pressure because they also use physical strength in their work. This response felt unexpected and somewhat unprofessional.

In my case, the therapist left in the middle of the session without any notice and was gone for a while before returning. This disrupted the flow of the massage and made the experience feel inconsistent and less attentive.

Overall, the experience felt underwhelming compared to expectations, both in terms of service and overall quality. There is definitely room for improvement.
reviews.textTranslated:
I was quite disappointed with this experience, as I had higher expectations.

From the moment we entered, the welcome wasn't very friendly, and the shop only accepts cash and credit cards, which might be inconvenient for some customers these days as QR codes are widely used.

As for the massage itself, the atmosphere wasn't conducive to relaxation. The room was noticeably hot; it felt like getting a massage in the middle of Dubai.
My friend requested more pressure because she uses her muscles a lot, but the staff responded that they could only do so much, as they also use their strength for work. This felt strange and unprofessional.

For me, during the massage, the staff member left without prior notice and disappeared for a while before returning to continue the service. This disrupted the flow of the experience and made it feel like small details weren't given enough attention.

Overall, it was a rather disappointing experience compared to what I expected, both in terms of atmosphere and service. I think there are still many points that should be improved.

reviews.name: Ian Blair
reviews.text:
Went to the old place a couple of years ago, and didn't like the ambience lack of privacy and the massage was not great. So when I saw they had moved to a new building I thought I would give it a try.
When I went in she seemed very keen to take the money, and after I had paid she took me to the room and said the masseuse will be along in a minute, between 20-25 minutes later a girl showed up who was very obviously not blind in a tunic from one of the local shops. First thing she did was start talking on her phone, then periodically throughout the massage was playing with her phone. The massage itself was one of the worst I have suffered, she uses the point of her elbow to dig in your back, when she's not using elbows she's using forearms. The only time she uses hand is when she is using one hand to play with phone. Totally unsatisfactory massage. Why did the manager just not say I have no one free can you comeback later. I think she's very greedy.
Just to be clear, this is the blind massage shop in Naklua which is 350 baht.
Not the TBMI shop in Jomtien which is a very much better service and cheaper at 250 baht.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
(Go to where you like... This isn't Jomtien, and not everyone in Jomtien is blind, stupid, and wants to show off their knowledge. You pathetic foreigner.) *** Preferences are a matter of individual taste. We and Jomtien are different styles, and we cater to different customer groups. How can we expect everyone to be the same?

ถ้าเป็นเป็นเรื่องจริง ฉันก็ว่ามันแย่ นะคะ ที่ร้านได้บริการแบบนี้ แต่คุณก็ทราบ ก่อนนวดว่า ภายใน 15 นาที  คุณสามารถ ยุติการนวด หรือ เปลี่ยนหมอนวด ได้ เมื่อ ไม่พอใจในการบริการ  ร้านยินดีคืนเงินเต็มตำนวน และพร้อม ปรับปรุงแก้ ไข เพื่อแก้ปัญหาให้คุณพอใจได้ 
     แต่ทำไมคุณยอมทนนอนนวดจนจบ เพื่ออะไรถ้ามันนวดที่แย่ขนาดนั่น แล้ว อีกอย่างเราไม่เคยให้หมอนวดพกโทรศัพท์ขึ้นนวด ถ้าหมอคนไหน พกขึ้นไปคือ ผิดกฎของร้าน เรามีกล้องวงจรปิด คุณคงลืมดู 
    การที่คุณไม่ได้มานวดจริงแต่มาเพื่อ ก่อกวน สร้างความเสียหาย หรืออยากมานวดฟรีก็ตาม 
 ทางร้านเรา ยินดีที่จะไม่รับเงินและ ให้บริการ สำหรับคุณ เราไม่ต้องการแลก ชื่อเสียงของร้าน 350 ซึ่งมันคือราคานวดไทยออย (น้ำมัน) พฤติกรรมของคุณที่ พยายาม โชว์ของสงวนให้หมอนวดดู พอหมอนวดไม่ตอบสนองในสิ่งที่คุณต้องการ คุณก็ไม่พอใจ ที่นี้เรานวดอย่างเดียวไม่ได้ บริการทางเพศ รู้ไว้ซะ !!
  
If this is true, then I think it's terrible service. But I want to ask you, are you stupid, or did you not bring your brain with you? If our massage service was bad, or you didn't like it, you could have stopped the massage within 15 minutes or come down to complain. We would listen and be ready to improve and give you a full refund. But why did you endure the entire hour-long massage? Besides, you're old enough to distinguish between right and wrong. You didn't come for a real massage, but to cause trouble and damage. We don't want your petty 250 baht. Remember that. Thai people aren't weaklings. Your dissatisfaction isn't with the service; it's simply that the shop charged you for the massage beforehand. This prevents you from getting a free massage without paying. You feel cheated.

Best of the best!! Don't be afraid, highly recommended!

Massage therapist Nan's oil massage is incredibly powerful, one of the few truly amazing massages I've had in Thailand! She perfectly targets the meridians and acupoints, with just the right amount of pressure throughout, easily adjustable to the touch. She's also fluent in both Chinese and English.

I wish I could come to her every day!

**I've had many disappointing experiences at other massage parlors in Chiang Mai, with so many therapists not hitting my points!**

**So, although this place doesn't look very new and has a retro decor, the massage therapists are truly skilled!** 500 baht per hour might not be the cheapest in the area, but the skill and service are so exceptional that I'll definitely fly back to Chiang Mai for a massage again!

reviews.text: セラピストによるとは思いますが、私を担当してくれたjoyさんは、非常に上手でした。フットマッサージを受けました。初めは痛いと言いましたが、それからは痛い手前ギリギリで施術してくれました。思わず寝てしまうほど気持ちよかったです？フットマッサージで寝たのは初めてでした。周りのセラピストとも話もすることなく1時間きっちりやってくれました。おかげさまで、とても疲れて痛いくらいだった脚の痛みが次の日の朝には取れていました。
reviews.textTranslated: I suppose it depends on the therapist, but Joy, who was in charge of me, was extremely skilled. I received a foot massage. At first I said it hurt, but after that she massaged me right up to the point where it was almost painful. It felt so good that I almost fell asleep! It was the first time I'd ever fallen asleep during a foot massage. She worked on me for a full hour without talking to the other therapists. Thanks to her, the pain in my legs, which had been so tired and aching, was gone by the next morning.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text: During the massage, the therapist asked for a "special massage" (sexual service). When I refused, her attitude immediately turned extremely hostile. After the session, she got furious and started yelling in Thai just because I gave a smaller tip. If they are going to act like this, they should upfront state the price for a "total vybe" (TV) from the beginning. They lure you in by being friendly at first, but then make unreasonable demands and throw a tantrum when they don't get what they want. The massage itself wasn't even the main issue; their unprofessional behavior makes me never want to visit this place again. Stay away.
