I was on my way to the Night Bazaar but it wasn't open, so I had some time to kill. I wandered around the area and found this massage shop.

It is very spacious, clean, and friendly.

It is 50 baht cheaper than in Chiang Mai Old Town. Great!

reviews.name: J K
reviews.text: I have had a lot of foot massages in Chiang Mai since I walk everywhere for health. 50km a week. Most of them were not even a real massage, just a calf rubbing for an hour. You've probably experienced this crap at many places. This place is the real deal. The young lady with a fair complexion (and strong hands!!!) gave me one of the best foot massages ever. I would definitely return.

reviews.name: Dl Tkfkd
reviews.text:
첫 번째 방문

꿀잠 잘 만큼 시원했고 압 조절도 좋았어요! 👍
다만 의자를 눕히면 허리 부분이 떠서 불편했습니다.

두 번째 방문

남녀노소 누구나 만족할 만한 마사지 실력이었어요. 😊
에어컨이 다소 추웠고, 이번에도 의자 때문에 허리 통증이 있었습니다.

세 번째 방문

발마사지 1시간과 타이마사지 1시간을 받았는데, 특히 타이마사지가 정말 시원했어요! 😂👍

친절한 직원분들, 합리적인 가격, 높은 마사지 퀄리티까지 만족스러워 치앙마이에 있는 동안 계속 방문할 것 같습니다. 강력 추천합니다! 👍👏
reviews.textTranslated:
First Visit

It was refreshing enough to get a good night's sleep, and the pressure was well-adjusted! 👍

However, it was uncomfortable because the lower back area lifted up when I reclined the chair.

Second Visit

The massage skills were good enough to satisfy everyone, regardless of age or gender. 😊

The air conditioning was a bit cold, and I experienced back pain again due to the chair.

Third Visit

I received a 1-hour foot massage and a 1-hour Thai massage, and the Thai massage was especially refreshing! 😂👍

I was satisfied with the friendly staff, reasonable prices, and high-quality massage, so I think I will keep visiting while I am in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended! 👍👏

基本的に60分のプランしかないですね

The place is very spacious, so you can easily get in even during the night bazaar. It would be nice if there was a place to put your belongings next to the chairs.

Basically, they only offer 60-minute plans.

title: Sunshine Massage School
ownerDescription:
Sunshine Massage School is an authentic gateway to learning Thai Traditional Massage in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

We welcome serious students seeking an enriching cultural experience, up to working therapists looking to deepen their skills.

Our signature 10-day beginner's course, starting every Monday year-round, provides a strong foundation in this ancient healing art, following the holistic approach of Asokananda.

Join us to explore Thai massage therapy principles and traditional medicine in a welcoming, professional environment. Whether you're a novice or experienced practitioner, Sunshine Massage School is your destination to learn the art of Thai Yoga massage in Thailand.

ownerUpdates.text:
Two 5-day courses (30 hours each), in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Anatomy & Osteopathy for Thai Massage.

Week 1, 8 to 12 February: The Central Axis, spine and pelvis. 
Week 2, 15 to 19 February: The Extremities, lower and upper limbs. 

Each week can be taken alone, but most students take both.
Open to all levels and styles of Thai massage experience.

Thierry Bienfaisant bridges the foundations of osteopathy with applied anatomy to refine your Thai massage technique. You localize and palpate the key structures of the musculoskeletal system, understand the biomechanics, innervation and vascularization behind them, and then apply that knowledge through Thai massage stretching, slow deep pressure, acupressure and dynamic techniques to release tension and restore mobility. By the end, anatomy becomes a clear 3D picture of the body that gives your practice orientation and precision, and you learn to structure a session around preparation, action and integration.

Baht 11,500 ( approx EUR 317) per week

5-day workshop (30 hours), Chiang Mai, Thailand

25 to 29 January 2027

For Thai massage practitioners; prior knowledge of Ayurveda is helpful but not required.

Traditional Thai massage works along the Sip Sen, the ten energy lines through which vital life force is believed to flow. In this workshop with Sukha you study the location and function of each of the ten lines and their associated Marma points, learn to palpate and assess them for blockages, and practice working the points by hand.

The aim is practical: by the end you can assess a client's needs and design a customized 60-minute session that targets specific imbalances, using the Lotus Palm Advanced Manual as reference. The course also introduces assessment through the Five Kosha bodies and works on developing intuition and sensitivity in Sen line work.

5 days / 30 hours, Baht 12,500 ( approx. EUR 335 )

5-day workshop (30 hours), Chiang Mai.
For intermediate and advanced Thai massage practitioners.

18 to 22 January 2027

Dynamic Thai Massage is a style of continuous movement in which giver and receiver fall into the same rhythm. Developed in Europe by David Lutt and Takis Oikonomou and inspired by the late Ajahn Chaiyuth Priyasith, it combines techniques from Thai massage with rocking, shaking and harmonic techniques borrowed from osteopathy.

With Flora you work on fluidity, continuity and changes of rhythm in a treatment, with the main focus on restoring movement of the spine, opening the ribcage and freeing the breath, working the sen lines with rocking techniques, and bringing mobility back to the main joints. The class is intensive, playful, and meant to be enjoyed by both sides of the mat.

5-day workshop, Baht 13,500 ( approx. EUR 371 )

4-day workshop, in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

18 to 21 January 2027

For massage therapists with Thai massage experience.

Most of us start with thumbs and hands, then move on to elbows and knees. Your feet and body weight can do much of that work instead, saving your wrists, thumbs and knees for a long career. In this workshop with Sukha you learn one-foot and two-foot techniques for kneading, rocking and acupressure, how to judge the right amount of pressure, and how to integrate foot work into a full-body Thai session.

The course puts strong emphasis on body mechanics, positioning and weight distribution so you work safely, plus sen line stimulation, adapting techniques to each client, and communicating with clients so they stay comfortable.

4-day workshop (24 hours in total), 
THB 10,500.  (approx. 274 €)

5-day workshop (30 hours), in Chiang Mai, Thailand. 
Open to anyone with a background in Thai massage.

23 to 27 November 2026

Roni Gilboa has spent more than 20 years working with cancer patients and their caregivers, and teaching massage therapists how to work safely in that setting. This course covers what cancer treatment does to the body, what palliative massage asks of the practitioner, how to adapt pressure, position and intention, and how to hold your own ground while doing it.

Roni's Touch Therapies method blends traditional Thai massage, Shiatsu and fascia work.

Baht 11,500 ( approx. EUR 314 )

Advanced Thai Massage Course in Chiang Mai – 3 Weeks with Itzhak Helman

16 November – 4 December 2026

Join Itzhak Helman for a special 3-week Advanced Thai Massage Training 

This 15-day / 90-hour program covers:
	•	Week 1: Thai Massage for Lower Back Conditions
	•	Week 2: Whole Massage in Side Position
	•	Week 3: Focus on the Spine
Explore advanced Thai Massage techniques and approaches, including work with the feet, lumbar area, pelvis, sacroiliac joint, energy lines, side position, spine, neck, shoulders and related structures.

Price: 34,500 THB for the complete 3-week program

This course is designed specifically for Active Practitioners and Advanced students.

reviews.textTranslated: I went based on the reviews, but... well. A woman gave me the massage, and for the entire hour, she just kept pressing hard. She also pressed indiscriminately on the front of my shins and knees, so it hurt a lot. She did adjust the pressure when I showed signs of pain midway through, but since it was the first massage I'd had since arriving in Chiang Mai, I wondered if this is what authentic Thai massages are supposed to be like. I've had manual therapy and chiropractic treatments many times, but I don't know if this was refreshing. It felt like I just walked out after being subjected to intense pressing for an entire hour... It wasn't bad enough to make me feel like I wasted my money, but I don't think I'll visit again. I think I'll be able to compare it to other massage shops. It seems like opinions are divided on this place.

The Spa includes five private treatment rooms, a glorious open-air traditional teak massage pavilion beside the pool and a spacious suite specially designed for couples or friends wishing to share their spa experience.

Whether you are looking to rejuvenate tired skin, relieve stress, overcome jet lag or soothe away aches and pains, we invite you to stop by Lotus Spa.

reviews.textTranslated:
My first time experiencing facial gua sha!
I got a great deal at 690 baht for 30 minutes. I decided to try it out, because I've only ever had body massages and regular facial treatments before.

At first, I thought it was just gua sha.
The process was very detailed and meticulous, from cleansing and facial massage to gua sha, face mask, and finishing with a shoulder, neck, and head massage – completely relaxing!
It exceeded my expectations. I'll definitely be back next time.
The staff were lovely, polite, and provided excellent service.
The place is beautiful, spacious, and airy, with a lovely, pleasant spa scent throughout the room.
I had some expectations, but this exceeded them.
If you enjoy spa treatments, I highly recommend this place!

reviews.text:
The place is super close to Holiday Inn Express and stays open really late, so you can get a great night's sleep right after. Each stuff has their own technique, but they’re all professional. I had such a great experience so that I went three days in a row.
On the first day, the stuff who worked on me was so attentive, kindness, and polite, with a really warm smile. Even though she was young, she had amazing technique—the pressure and stretching were spot-on and super impressive. I exercise very often, so my muscles are always tight, but right after the massage, my body felt completely relaxed.
The stuff on the second day gave me a great back massage, so ask for her if you need extra focus there.
On the third day, the stuff was very friendly and spoke decent Chinese. Her technique was sophisticated, and she even kindly taught me a few Thai words.
The owner is also wonderful and speaks Thai, English, and Chinese fluently. The menu out front has a ton of options, all translated into multiple languages, which is thoughtful.
All in all, if you're staying near the Holiday Inn Express and looking for a massage, I highly recommend coming here. Everyone is nice.

reviews.name: X T
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed my massage here. The staff were warm, friendly, and welcoming from the moment I arrived.

The massage itself was excellent. My masseur was very strong, which I personally like, but also very accurate. She quickly found the tight areas and knew exactly where to focus. It was not just strong pressure everywhere. The massage felt targeted, effective, and very well done.

I have tried quite a few massage places in Chiang Mai over the years, and this is definitely one of the better ones for me. Good technique, strong pressure, and very friendly service.

Parking is also quite convenient if you are driving, with roadside parking available nearby.

Overall, I had a very good experience and would happily come back again. If you enjoy a proper strong massage with someone who can really find the right spots, this place is definitely worth trying. Highly recommended.

reviews.textTranslated:
The massage was okay. The location is good, with parking right next to the street, very convenient. The staff were attentive.
However, the staff didn't wash their hands before massaging my head.
**I recommend washing hands before head massage 🙏**

**Be cautious when massaging smaller clients.**
There were some bone-related issues, which I understand because smaller clients might have more difficult massages.
- The arm stretching and arm-pressing movements were very forceful, which startled me a little 😂
- During the sitting-up arm massage, the lower arm felt like a pinch 55

Overall, the massage was good. I usually get massages regularly, and I would consider returning.

reviews.text: 3天去了兩次，一次足部按摩一小時，一次油壓2小時，個人覺得按摩技術還不錯價格也便宜，但第三次前去店裡有3個工作人員在椅子上划手機，卻冷冷的說很忙沒空接待我的按摩，我覺得員工的待人接物有待加強，感覺太冷漠。今天晚上6點又前去，店裡有2個工作人員，我站在門口沒進門訊問現在可以按摩嗎？一個工作人員說可以開門讓我進去並問做何種按摩，我指著價目表說2小時油壓（700），他按計算機700＋200＝900問我ok嗎？這是變相加價嗎？哪有人指定小費200的？我回no，他便說go把我趕了出來，真是傻眼，在這我只陳述事實供想去這家按摩店的人參考
reviews.textTranslated: I went twice in three days, once for a one-hour foot massage and once for a two-hour oil massage. I thought the massage technique was pretty good and the price was cheap. However, on my third visit, three staff members were sitting on their phones, coldly saying they were too busy to serve me. I felt the staff's manners needed improvement; they seemed too indifferent. I went again at 6 pm tonight. There were two staff members. I stood at the door and asked if I could get a massage. One staff member said he could open the door and asked what kind of massage I wanted. I pointed to the price list and said two hours of oil massage (700). He calculated 700 + 200 = 900 and asked if that was okay. Is this a disguised price increase? Who expects a 200 tip? I said no, and he said "go" and kicked me out. I was dumbfounded. I'm just stating the facts for anyone considering this massage parlor.

reviews.textTranslated:
I didn't really like it. I went with my mom twice. The first time, for a foot massage, it was 300 baht. We found some nice girls and enjoyed the massage. The second floor had a more pleasant atmosphere.

The second time, we went for a back and leg massage. We've had other massage therapists (there are a lot of them there), and they were completely rubbish. They just stroked my back and legs. They talked loudly the whole time.

The place isn't bad, but the massage is a matter of luck.

The first time we went, we liked the massage.
The second time, they just stroked our feet, and we asked to change. The fact that the masseuses don't know how to massage is just awful. Not everyone here knows how to massage. If you get a good masseuse in turn, you're lucky!

reviews.name: David
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience.

I booked an aromatherapy massage, but there was nothing aromatic about it. It was just basic oil, with no aromatherapy experience at all.

The massage itself was dreadful. The therapist essentially just ran his hands over my skin without applying any meaningful pressure or technique. He also used far too much oil; it genuinely felt as though he had simply opened the bottle and poured it all over me.

Halfway through the massage, he asked me for a 1,000 baht tip. I would have been more than happy to pay this, had the massage been good. Unfortunately, it was nowhere near the standard I expected. The therapist also seemed completely uninterested, giving the impression that he didn't want to be there. The original price of the massage was 900 baht, so I would expect a decent massage for that.

After he asked for 1,000 baht, I said I would give him 500 baht instead, but this made the rest of the experience awkward and uncomfortable.

Overall, I was extremely disappointed with both the quality of the massage and the experience itself. There are plenty of other massage places along this street, and I would recommend trying one of those before coming here.

Nuttaya Wongsang
Spa Manager

*** ประทับใจหมอน หายใจออกแม้นอนคว่ำ ***
reviews.textTranslated:
The shop has a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, giving off a vibe of meeting friends. You can request specific pressure points or adjust the intensity during the massage. The masseuse had good pressure.

Perhaps because the room was a bit dark, there was occasional conversation towards the end of the massage. I think the masseuse was getting sleepy and started chatting to keep them awake, both from her own room and the next room (early evening). This made the atmosphere in the shop not entirely quiet, but not noisy either. It felt like a casual chat between girlfriends. If you're not bothered by this, it's quite good. Not suitable for people who want to fall asleep during a massage.

The aromatherapy oil was a bit sticky. The scent and comfort weren't as good as a Thai massage. Personally, I recommend a regular oil massage or a Thai massage with deep tissue work instead.

*** I was impressed with the pillow; I could breathe even while lying face down. ***

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience

I made an appointment at Holi Health Icon in Bangkok, and my appointment was confirmed. I arrived well before the scheduled time, only to be told that they had not received my booking.

Instead of trying to find a solution, I was told that I could wait for **90 minutes** or go for a walk and come back.

I find this extremely unprofessional. If an appointment is confirmed, the customer should be able to rely on it. At the very least, I would have expected an apology and a reasonable solution rather than being asked to simply wait for 90 minutes.

Very disappointing experience and a complete waste of my time.

The point is, the massage wasn't a full hour. They really did close. The massage was less than 5 minutes long; they were in such a rush. This was definitely not my first time there; it was so uncomfortable.

reviews.name: Софья Таранюк
reviews.text: It was the worst massage of my life. I have been living in Phuket for 6 years and have known this place since the Covid days. I haven't visited it for the last few years, but when my friend arrived, I wanted to show her a real Thai massage and booked a 3-hour package. When we entered the room, everything was covered in oil. You literally slide across the floor. Then the massage began, and we understood why. The masseuse simply pours oil on you, spreads it over one area of your body, and moves on to the next. It's hard to call it a massage. You just lie there covered in oil and don't get any pleasant sensations. The girls simply DON'T KNOW how to give a massage. It was so bad that we just wanted to get up and leave, even though we paid 1,900 baht for two for this procedure. It was evening and the administrator was no longer there. The next day, I wrote to the administrator personally on WhatsApp, she thanked me for the information and that was it. She said it was very nice of me not to bother her in the evening. I said that it would be very nice of her to offer me a solution, give me a discount on a massage with a good specialist, and refund part of the money. After that, she stopped responding. I do not recommend anyone visit this place. They will make you feel uncomfortable for your money, and you will not receive any service here either.

reviews.name: 정영주
reviews.text:
사장님 목소리가 제일 커요. 사장님부터 조용히 해주셨으면 좋겠구요. 마사지 하는 중간에 불쑥 들어와서 괜찮냐고 묻는거 불쾌했어요. 마사지사 앞에 두고 별로다고 할만큼 용기있지 않습니다. 마사지 추가 요금 더 내고 변경이 안되는 것도 웃기지만 120분 타이마사지 90분 발마사지로 변경했는데 저에게 본인이 결정하신거라며 압박? 하신건 제가 차액 돌려달라고 할까봐 그러신건가요? 금액도 말해주지 않고 변경불가, 환불불가라고 하시는 것 정말 별로였어요. 발마사지 체어도 아니고 그냥 타이 마사지 침대에 누워서 받는건지도 몰랐네요. 남편은 2시간도 안 해주더라구요? 여러 가지로 별로였어요

지인에겐 팁 어떻게 줄거냐고 압박? 하셨다죠.. 팁은 고객의 선택입니다. 지인에게도 조용히 하라고 하셨다는데 할말하않입니다
reviews.textTranslated:
The owner has the loudest voice. I wish the owner would be quiet first. It was unpleasant when they barged in during the massage to ask if I was okay. I don't have the courage to tell the masseuse right in front of her that it wasn't good. It's ridiculous that I can't change the massage even if I pay extra, but I changed the 120-minute Thai massage to a 90-minute foot massage, and they pressured me by saying it was their decision. Was that because they were afraid I would ask for the difference back? It was really unpleasant that they didn't even tell me the price and just said changes and refunds were impossible. I didn't even realize I was supposed to lie on a regular Thai massage bed, not a foot massage chair. They didn't even give my husband two hours. It was bad in many ways.

I heard they pressured an acquaintance about how they would tip... Tipping is the customer's choice. I heard they told the acquaintance to be quiet as well, but I have nothing to say.

reviews.textTranslated:
I was very impressed with my stay here. The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful, perfect for relaxation. The rooms are clean.
What I liked most was that there were activities to do, not just a place to sleep. For example, the tennis court that you can book to play was a lot of fun. It's suitable for coming with friends, your partner, or family, making the trip anything but boring.
Overall, it was worth the price paid. You get great accommodation and activities to enjoy. If I have the opportunity to come to this area again, I will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Helenachou
reviews.text: I made my reservation via booking.com looking to stay somewhere close to black mountains golf course. However I did not realize that this particular unit that was posted under the name “Mango Paradise in der nahe black mountain golf clubs” is more of a private residence managed and maintained by Mango spa and resort. The interior is old and tattered with mold everywhere. I was expecting a resort where there is proper bedding, towels, toiletries etc… there is just old used towels and ripped mattresses and not even hand soaps for general cleaning. Various small corners brings hygiene concerns and just in really|Poor condition. Safety also poses as a great issue as the front door is just held together by an old fashion doorknob lock. I would not ever stay here. The resort staff is very nice and felt really sorry for us as the owner also grossly overcharged us for our stay. My bad for not doing more research. This is a no no no no no, and makes holiday inn looks like a six star establishment.

reviews.textTranslated:
I tried a massage at this shop today and I was very impressed from the moment I stepped in. The atmosphere is quiet, clean, and has a relaxing fragrance. The staff were very welcoming, smiling, and explained the services in detail.

The masseuse was extremely professional. She pressed on the right spots, the pressure was just right, and it wasn't too painful. After the massage, I felt light and my aches and pains were clearly relieved.

Overall, it was well worth it – the service, the location, and the quality were all excellent. I give it 5 stars without hesitation! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.textTranslated:
The service was good. The body scrub and massage were excellent. It's a shame there aren't private rooms; they only use curtains to separate the beds. After the herbal steam treatment was finished, no staff member came to check on me, and they didn't hear me when I called. I had to use the phone to get their attention.
It would be much better if the staff could improve their presentation.

reviews.textTranslated:
The best hydrafacial I've ever had! It was amazing! The girl had a light touch and wasn't rough at all. Honestly, it was fantastic, no exaggeration.

She also gave me a wonderful face, neck, and head massage. The price was perfect, and the girl's name is Mei. She's very nice and kind.

I also tried the scrub, and it was amazing! Words can't describe the feeling. It was so clean and pampering, everything was natural, and the scrub was warm. The girl who did it was also great and genuinely dedicated. Her name is Far. Honestly, they deserve 10 stars. It's one of the best massages in Phuket.

reviews.textTranslated:
I had a men's massage and a hair spa.

The specialist, Naa, did my hair very comfortably; her hand was gentle and she didn't pull or cut my hair. The session was so relaxing and comfortable, I loved it! 🤍🤍 It felt like my first time washing my hair 🤣 It was amazing!

Finally, she dried my hair, and it wasn't just any old thing—she sectioned and styled it perfectly, like a blow dryer.

Of course, there are private rooms for women who wear hijab, closed and private.

The men's massage cost 400 baht.
The hair spa cost 19,000 baht.

The place was very clean, organized, and professional.

reviews.name: 生駒泰斗
reviews.text:
足マッサージと全身マッサージ450Bを依頼
足マッサージ良い
全身マッサージで2階に連れて行かれました。
技術は酷いもんです。むしろ痛くなりました。
更に30分経過した時に、ハンド1000Bと提案され、要らないと言うと500Bでと提案されました。非常に気分は最悪でした。
口コミを見る限り、普通のマッサージと思ってただけに返金して欲しいレベルでした
reviews.textTranslated:
I requested a foot massage and a full-body massage for 450B.
The foot massage was good.
I was taken upstairs for the full-body massage.
The technique was terrible. It actually became painful.
After another 30 minutes, I was offered a hand massage for 1000B, and when I said no, I was offered it for 500B. I was extremely upset.
Based on the reviews, I was expecting a normal massage, so I wanted a refund.
